researcher.sentenceEn: While the researchers focus primarily on the difficulties that these disorderly, crowded memories may pose, they also highlight a few situations in which these same memory patterns may be useful.
researcher.translationZh: 虽然研究人员主要关注这些混乱、碎片化的记忆可能带来的困难，但他们也强调了在某些情况下，这些相同的记忆模式可能是有用的。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

researcher.sentenceEn: While this wealth of prior knowledge can make memory retrieval challenging, the researchers say it has its upsides—this life experience can aid with creativity and decision-making.
researcher.translationZh: 虽然丰富的先前知识会使记忆提取变得困难，但研究人员表示这也有其优势——这些生活经验有助于提升创造力和决策能力。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

researcher.sentenceEn: Researchers Tarek Amer, Jordana Wynn and Lynn Hasher looked at several behavioral and brain imaging studies, which show that older adults have difficulty suppressing information that is no longer relevant and that when searching for a specific memory, they often retrieve other, irrelevant memories along with it.
researcher.translationZh: 研究人员塔里克·阿米尔、乔丹娜·韦恩和林恩·哈舍查看了几项行为和脑成像研究，这些研究表明，老年人难以抑制不再相关的信息，并且在搜索特定记忆时，他们往往会同时检索到其他不相关的记忆。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

researcher.sentenceEn: In a review published in the journal *Trends in Cognitive Sciences* on February 11th, researchers propose an explanation for why this might be happening: the brains of older adults allocate more space to accumulated knowledge and have more material to navigate when attempting to access memories.
researcher.translationZh: 在2月11日发表于《认知科学趋势》期刊的一篇综述中，研究人员对这种现象提出了一种解释：老年人的大脑为积累的知识分配了更多空间，在试图提取记忆时需要处理更多信息。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

researcher.sentenceEn: According to the researchers of the new study, stray dogs are intelligent creatures.
researcher.translationZh: 这项新研究的研究人员表示，流浪狗是聪明的生物。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

researcher.sentenceEn: How did the researchers turn on the music toy in their experiment?
researcher.translationZh: 研究人员在实验中是如何启动这个音乐玩具的？

relationship.sentenceEn: They can generalize such abstract concepts as causal relationships and social roles from just a few examples.
relationship.translationZh: 他们仅从少数几个例子中就能归纳出因果关系和社会角色等抽象概念。
relationship.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

relationship.sentenceEn: They assert that although doing some work might be necessary, meaning, purpose and social value reside in the communities and relationships built and sustained outside of the workplace.
relationship.translationZh: 他们认为，尽管从事一些工作可能是必要的，但生活的意义、目标和社会价值存在于工作场所以外建立和维系的社区与人际关系中。
relationship.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

relationship.sentenceEn: Nurturing a few solid relationships without feeling the need to constantly populate your life with endless chatting ultimately may be better for you.
relationship.translationZh: 精心培养几段稳固的关系，不必总觉得需要让生活充斥着没完没了的闲聊，这最终可能对你更好。

relationship.sentenceEn: The more it was present, the worse they considered both the quality of the interaction and the quality of the relationship .
relationship.translationZh: 这种情况出现的频率越高，他们对互动质量和关系质量的评价就越低。
relationship.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

relationship.sentenceEn: It may turn out to be better for one to cultivate a few steady relationships than to busy themselves socialising.
relationship.translationZh: 与其忙于社交，不如用心经营几个稳定的关系，这可能会更好。

relationship.sentenceEn: They looked into the relationship between one's prior knowledge and creativity.
relationship.translationZh: 他们研究了一个人的先验知识与创造力之间的关系。

risk.sentenceEn: Fourth, automation puts jobs and wages at risk .
risk.translationZh: 第四，自动化使就业岗位和工资面临风险。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

risk.sentenceEn: But these conventionally managed campuses can come at a cost: increased cancer risk , contaminated waterways, poisoned wildlife and lifeless soil.
risk.translationZh: 但这些传统管理的校园可能会付出代价：癌症风险增加、水道污染、野生动物中毒以及土壤失去生机。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

risk.sentenceEn: In the UK, the Royal College of General Practitioners says that loneliness has the same risk level for premature death as diabetes.
risk.translationZh: 在英国，皇家全科医师学院表示，孤独对过早死亡的风险等级与糖尿病相当。

risk.sentenceEn: These real health benefits include better cognitive functioning and lowered risk of gaining weight.
risk.translationZh: 这些切实的健康益处包括改善认知功能以及降低体重增加的风险。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

risk.sentenceEn: New research looked at people who increased their exercise levels after their 40s beyond levels they had when they were younger and those individuals showed declines in their risk of early mortality which were similar to those of people who exercised consistently throughout their lives.
risk.translationZh: 最新研究显示，在40岁后增加锻炼强度、甚至超过年轻时期水平的人群，其早逝风险的降幅与终身坚持锻炼的人群相似。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

risk.sentenceEn: It puts jobs and wages at risk .

reduce.sentenceEn: They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences.
reduce.translationZh: 他们还认为，学校能够通过减少学生缺课来进行有效干预。
reduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

reduce.sentenceEn: Pesticide use also decreases the life in soil, hampering the ability of soils to absorb carbon or retain water and thus reducing campuses' ability to recover quickly from climate-related extreme weather events like droughts and floods.
reduce.translationZh: 农药的使用还会减少土壤中的生物活性，削弱土壤吸收碳和保持水分的能力，从而降低校园从干旱和洪水等气候相关极端天气事件中快速恢复的能力。
reduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

reduce.sentenceEn: "This work reminds me to be in the present moment as I play my role in reducing herbicide use and keeping my campus safe and healthy," says Charlene.
reduce.translationZh: 夏琳说：“这项工作提醒我，在为减少除草剂使用、保障校园安全健康贡献力量时，要活在当下。”
reduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

reduce.sentenceEn: Some activists have even called for taxing meat to reduce consumption of it.
reduce.translationZh: 一些活动人士甚至呼吁对肉类征税以减少其消费。

reduce.sentenceEn: Changes in America's farming technology and management in the past decades have increased efficiency and reduced greenhouse gas emissions in meat production.
reduce.translationZh: 过去几十年，美国农业技术和管理的变革提高了肉类生产的效率，同时减少了温室气体排放。

reduce.sentenceEn: Children's academic performance depends on reducing the number of absences.
reduce.translationZh: 儿童的学业成绩取决于减少缺勤次数。

rate.sentenceEn: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.
rate.translationZh: 事实上，美国推出家庭休假政策后，性别工资差距的缩小速度降至每年仅0.03个百分点，此后一直维持在这一水平。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

rate.sentenceEn: Though the leave policies might have helped those women to stay in the workplace—instead of dropping out to have families—those who returned saw their wages had increased at lower rates than the men.
rate.translationZh: 尽管休假政策可能帮助这些女性留在职场——而不是为了家庭而辞职——但那些重返职场的女性发现，她们的薪资增长率低于男性。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

rate.sentenceEn: It's hard to make a compelling argument that the United States has a calorie deficit, given its high national rates of adult and child obesity.
rate.translationZh: 鉴于美国成人和儿童肥胖率居高不下，很难让人相信美国存在热量摄入不足的问题。

rate.sentenceEn: But ultimately the chance to reduce overheads(管理费用) by employing fewer people or at lower rates will be what attracts big brands to technology.
rate.translationZh: 但最终，通过减少雇员数量或降低薪资水平来削减管理费用的机会，才是吸引各大品牌投身技术领域的核心动力。

rate.sentenceEn: Use them to remove yourself from the love you have for this idea and consider your burn rate relative to growth plan, industry growth rates , and other factors that predict start-up success.
rate.translationZh: 利用这些因素使自己从对这个想法的热爱中抽离出来，并结合增长计划、行业增长率以及其他预测初创公司成功的因素，冷静审视你的烧钱率。

rate.sentenceEn: The rate of gender wage convergence started to fall noticeably.
rate.translationZh: 性别工资趋同速度开始显著下降。

resource.sentenceEn: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.
resource.translationZh: 我还发现，宣扬追求个人热情会加剧社会不平等，因为并非每个人都拥有同样的经济资源，能够轻松追求自己的热爱。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

resource.sentenceEn: While the passion principle is broadly popular, not everyone has the necessary resources to turn their passion into a stable, good-paying job.
resource.translationZh: 虽然“追随热情”的理念广受欢迎，但并非每个人都拥有必要的资源，将自己的热情转化为一份稳定且收入不错的工作。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

resource.sentenceEn: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most.
resource.translationZh: 相反，我们建议将无故缺课作为一种信号，以便将资源导向最需要帮助的儿童和家庭。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

resource.sentenceEn: But practiced at its highest level, mise-en-place says that time is precious, resources are precious, space is precious, your self-respect and the respect of others are precious.
resource.translationZh: 但若能将"准备到位"（mise-en-place）发挥到极致，它所传达的是：时间宝贵，资源宝贵，空间宝贵，你的自尊与他人对你的尊重同样宝贵。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

resource.sentenceEn: Why do meaning and happiness have a weaker relationship in those with more resources ?
resource.translationZh: 为什么在资源更丰富的人群中，意义感与幸福感的关联更弱？

resource.sentenceEn: Use time and resources in a wise way.
resource.translationZh: 明智地利用时间和资源。

region.sentenceEn: But meat consumption per person in these regions still lags that of developed countries.
region.translationZh: 但这些地区的人均肉类消费量仍落后于发达国家。

region.sentenceEn: This is evident in how we have organized ourselves into various collective groups such as nations, regions , communities, organizations, and families.
region.translationZh: 这在我们组建的各种集体组织中显而易见，例如国家、地区、社区、机构以及家庭。
region.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

region.sentenceEn: The basal ganglia, the brain region linked to our performance of habits, is most active at the beginning of a behavior, when the habit is cued, and at the end, when it's rewarded.
region.translationZh: 基底神经节是与我们习惯执行相关的大脑区域，它在行为开始时（习惯被触发时）和结束时（获得奖励时）最为活跃。

region.sentenceEn: The short answer is that the brain regions that handle smells, memories and emotions are linked.
region.translationZh: 简而言之，大脑中处理气味、记忆和情绪的区域是相互关联的。
region.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

region.sentenceEn: A scent is a chemical particle that floats in through the nose and into the region of the brain responsible for smell, where the sensation is first processed into a form that the brain can read.
region.translationZh: 气味是一种化学微粒，它通过鼻子进入大脑中负责嗅觉的区域，在那里，这种感觉首先被处理成大脑能够识别的形式。
region.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

region.sentenceEn: A lot of headlines about moons are just ridiculous (you do not need to be particularly excited about a blue moon, it just looks like a regular full moon), but you should definitely roll out of bed to look at a blood moon if one is going to be visible in your region , even though they're just lunar eclipses and not evidence of bloody battles between the sky gods.
region.translationZh: 许多关于月亮的新闻标题都很荒谬（你不必对蓝月亮特别兴奋，它看起来就像普通的满月），但如果你的地区能看到血月，你绝对应该起床去看看，尽管它们只是月食，并非天空诸神之间血腥战斗的证据。

recently.sentenceEn: In a recently published article, philosopher Julian Baggini suggests we should focus on 'real wealth' for citizens, which does not depend on GDP growth.
recently.translationZh: 哲学家朱利安·巴吉尼在最近发表的一篇文章中建议，我们应当关注公民的'真正财富'，而这并不取决于GDP增长。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

recently.sentenceEn: As recently as the early 20th century, many Americans sewed their own clothing.
recently.translationZh: 直到20世纪初，许多美国人还依然自己缝制衣服。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

recently.sentenceEn: A certain species of fish recently passed the well-known mirror test.
recently.translationZh: 某种鱼类最近通过了著名的镜子测试。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

recently.sentenceEn: Research recently carried out by my team suggests that fish may be self-aware.
recently.translationZh: 我的团队最近进行的研究表明，鱼类可能具有自我意识。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

recently.sentenceEn: What does philosopher Julian Baggini suggest governments do in a recently published article?
recently.translationZh: 哲学家朱利安·巴吉尼在最近发表的一篇文章中建议政府做什么？

recently.sentenceEn: He has published a book recently .

reflect.sentenceEn: If we take the time to reflect we might recognise that as well as our work we can also identify as a friend, a spouse, a son or daughter, a parent, a member of a sports team or religious community.
reflect.translationZh: 如果我们花时间反思，可能会意识到，除了工作之外，我们还可以将自己定位为朋友、配偶、子女、父母、运动队成员或宗教团体成员。
reflect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

reflect.sentenceEn: When these bent light waves reach the other side of the water droplet, they reflect back out of the droplet instead of completely passing through the water.
reflect.translationZh: 当这些弯曲的光波到达水滴的另一侧时，它们会反射出水滴，而不是完全穿过水。
reflect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

reflect.sentenceEn: When light reflects off a water droplet, it simply bounces back in the opposite direction from where it originates.
reflect.translationZh: 当光线从水滴表面反射时，它会简单地朝着与来源方向相反的方向反弹回去。
reflect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

reflect.sentenceEn: The active involvement of users is reflected in the gamified(游戏化的) interaction offered by the social media platforms—the ability to like, write a comment, compare, share.
reflect.translationZh: 用户的积极参与体现在社交媒体平台提供的游戏化互动中——点赞、评论、比较、分享等功能。
reflect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

reflect.sentenceEn: The moon will appear orange when the light reflecting from it travels through an atmosphere thicker than usual.
reflect.translationZh: 当月球反射的光线穿过比平时更厚的大气层时，月亮会呈现出橙色。

reflect.sentenceEn: It reflects a person's exceptional endeavor.
reflect.translationZh: 这体现了一个人非凡的努力。

responsibility.sentenceEn: Strengthening neighborhoods and championing the cultural lives of communities are big responsibilities .
responsibility.translationZh: 强化社区建设和倡导社区文化生活是重大责任。

responsibility.sentenceEn: That means we have a responsibility to help them make connections between US history and current events.
responsibility.translationZh: 这意味着我们有责任帮助他们在美国历史与时事之间建立联系。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

responsibility.sentenceEn: The psychology behind this is called diffusion of responsibility .
responsibility.translationZh: 这背后的心理学原理被称为责任分散效应。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

responsibility.sentenceEn: This crowd mentality is strong enough for people to evade their known responsibilities .
responsibility.translationZh: 这种从众心理足以让人们逃避他们明知的责任。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

responsibility.sentenceEn: What does the author mean by "diffusion of responsibility " (Para. 3)?
responsibility.translationZh: 作者在第3段中提到的“责任扩散”是什么意思？

responsibility.sentenceEn: Help employees balance work and family responsibilities .
responsibility.translationZh: 帮助员工平衡工作与家庭责任

realize.sentenceEn: Because of this, food product placement within the appliance is far more important than you probably realize .
realize.translationZh: 正因为如此，家电内部的食品摆放位置远比你想象的重要得多。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

realize.sentenceEn: We realize that we can't get back the resources we've given, so we persevere — investing in a project that should be halted, staying in a relationship that should be over, or finishing a book we no longer enjoy and should put down, because we're already halfway through it.
realize.translationZh: 我们意识到无法收回已经投入的资源，于是选择坚持下去——即便是一个本该停止的项目也继续投资，一段本该结束的关系也苦苦维持，或者一本已经读不下去且本该放下的书，只因为已经读了一半就非要把它读完。

realize.sentenceEn: M: My father's current financial situation has helped me realize that a more financially viable employment opportunity is not necessarily a bad thing.
realize.translationZh: 男：我父亲目前的财务状况让我意识到，一个经济上更可行的就业机会未必是件坏事。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

realize.sentenceEn: But when we started creating it, we realized that was the same thing every girl was doing.
realize.translationZh: 但当我们开始着手创建博客时，却发现这不过是每个女孩都在做的事。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

realize.sentenceEn: Realizing they would not be able to afford their dream wedding, Susan's future husband suggested getting married in Las Vegas.
realize.translationZh: 意识到他们无法负担梦想中的婚礼，苏珊的未婚夫建议去拉斯维加斯结婚。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

realize.sentenceEn: They encourage these workers to realize their aspirations.
realize.translationZh: 他们鼓励这些员工实现自己的抱负。

reality.sentenceEn: We stop imagining the life we'd like to have or the person we'd like to be, quickly finding ourselves shattered by the pain of our reality .
reality.translationZh: 我们不再去想象自己想要的生活或想成为的人，很快就发现自己被现实的痛苦击垮。
reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

reality.sentenceEn: An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality , is specifically designed to maximize participant learning.
reality.translationZh: 作为一种学习工具，有效的模拟可能比实际经验更优越，因为它能加速时间、压缩空间，而且与现实不同，模拟是专门为最大限度提升参与者学习效果而设计的。
reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

reality.sentenceEn: Simulations provide an immersive learning experience where skills, processes and knowledge all can be highlighted in a way reality cannot.
reality.translationZh: 模拟提供沉浸式学习体验，能够以现实无法实现的方式突出技能、流程和知识。
reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

reality.sentenceEn: Allowing participants to enter a simulated environment provides them with the opportunity to experience alternative realities which can prompt them to rethink their current beliefs.
reality.translationZh: 让参与者进入模拟环境，能为他们提供体验另类现实的机会，这可能促使他们重新思考自己当前的信念。
reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reality.sentenceEn: To reap the benefits, however, simulations must feel like reality .
reality.translationZh: 然而，要想获得这些益处，模拟必须让人感觉如同现实一般。
reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

reality.sentenceEn: It is struggling to transform fiction into reality .
reality.translationZh: 它正努力将虚构变为现实。

reveal.sentenceEn: Surveys revealed that working-class and first-generation college graduates, regardless of their career field, are more likely than their wealthier peers to end up in low-paying unskilled jobs when they pursue their passion.
reveal.translationZh: 调查显示，工薪阶层和第一代大学毕业生无论从事何种职业领域，当他们追求自己热爱的事业时，比家境更优渥的同龄人更有可能从事低薪的非技术性工作。
reveal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

reveal.sentenceEn: The study revealed that 80% of participating dogs successfully followed pointing gestures to a specific location despite having never received prior training.
reveal.translationZh: 研究显示，80%参与实验的狗尽管从未接受过相关训练，仍能成功跟随指向手势找到特定位置。

reveal.sentenceEn: In the bowels of CFF's third dome, lab manager Gomathy Sethuraman opens a window into the centre's "crown jewels", revealing vines of winged beans growing under a bright yellow light.
reveal.translationZh: 在CFF第三穹顶的内部，实验室经理戈马西·塞图拉曼打开了一扇通往该中心“皇冠上的明珠”的窗户，展示着在明亮的黄色灯光下生长的四棱豆藤蔓。

reveal.sentenceEn: A survey conducted in the United States revealed that more than 50% filter the images before posting them.
reveal.translationZh: 美国的一项调查显示，超过50%的人在发布图片前会进行过滤处理。
reveal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

reveal.sentenceEn: What has a new study revealed about temperature?
reveal.translationZh: 一项新研究揭示了关于温度的什么发现？

reveal.sentenceEn: Reveal the undesired result of their approach.
reveal.translationZh: 揭示其方法所导致的不良后果。

respond.sentenceEn: In 2015, the U.S. secretary of education responded to this crisis, urging communities to support every student to attend every day and be successful in school.
respond.translationZh: 2015年，美国教育部长针对这一危机作出回应，呼吁各社区支持每一位学生每天到校上课并在学业上取得成功。
respond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

respond.sentenceEn: As uncomfortable as it may be to continuously receive, if you can respond with compassion, the situation will likely defuse much faster.
respond.translationZh: 尽管不断面对这些可能会让人感到不适，但如果你能以慈悲之心回应，情况往往会更快得到缓解。
respond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

respond.sentenceEn: The Turing test was conceived, you may recall, as a way of enabling humans to determine whether a machine could respond in such a way that one couldn't tell whether it was a human or a robot.
respond.translationZh: 你可能还记得，图灵测试的构思初衷是让人们能够判断：一台机器的反应是否已经达到了让人无法分辨其究竟是人类还是机器人的程度。
respond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

respond.translationZh: 你的大脑会对奖励做出反应。

respond.sentenceEn: How did the participants in the new study respond regarding phone use during social interactions?
respond.translationZh: 这项新研究的参与者如何评价社交活动中使用手机的行为？

respond.sentenceEn: It is of vital importance to respond promptly to the school absence crisis.
respond.translationZh: 对学生缺课危机做出迅速反应至关重要。

response.sentenceEn: Well-designed simulations can enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding about how their decisions and intuitive responses to business stimuli affect their fellow participants and the organization as a whole.
response.translationZh: 精心设计的模拟能够让个人和团队深入理解他们的决策以及对业务刺激的直觉反应如何影响其他参与者和整个组织。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

response.sentenceEn: If the act of giving advice is contributing actively to someone's feelings of self-worth, an outright(直率的) rejection may be perceived as a threat, activating their fight-or-flight response , possibly causing them to double down on their validation-seeking behavior, or leading to a larger conflict.
response.translationZh: 如果给予建议这一行为正积极地支撑着一个人的自我价值感，那么直接的拒绝可能会被视为一种威胁，从而激发其战斗或逃跑反应。这可能导致他们加倍寻求认可，或者引发更大的冲突。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

response.sentenceEn: It is possible that their emotions were only validated in childhood when they were at their loudest, encouraging them to adopt responses to discomfort that are excessive in most situations.
response.translationZh: 这可能是因为他们在童年时期，只有在闹得最凶时情绪才会得到认可，这促使他们养成了一种在大多数情况下都表现得过于激进的不适反应方式。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

response.sentenceEn: Perhaps in order to explore self-awareness further, we should stop looking at responses to the mirror as a decisive test.
response.translationZh: 或许为了进一步探索自我意识，我们不应再将对镜子反应视为一种决定性的测试。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

response.sentenceEn: According to one critic, the audience's warm response would encourage the musicians to do a better job.
response.translationZh: 一位评论家表示，观众的热烈反响会鼓励音乐家们表现得更好。

response.sentenceEn: It is a creative person's response to limitation.
response.translationZh: 这是创意人士对局限的回应。

rely.sentenceEn: The studies also showed that when given a cognitive task, older adults rely more heavily on previous knowledge than younger adults do.
rely.translationZh: 研究还表明，在执行认知任务时，老年人比年轻人更依赖先前的知识。
rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

rely.sentenceEn: Most institutions of higher education rely on synthetic pesticides and fertilizers to achieve aesthetic goals.
rely.translationZh: 大多数高等教育机构依靠合成农药和化肥来达到美观目的。
rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

rely.sentenceEn: But our happiness relies on collaborative efforts as a society.
rely.translationZh: 但我们的幸福依赖于整个社会的共同努力。
rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

rely.sentenceEn: Similarly, if you're looking for love advice, ask someone removed from the ups and downs of your relationship instead of relying only on your best friend.
rely.translationZh: 同样，如果你在寻求情感建议，与其只依赖最好的朋友，不如去请教那些置身于你的感情波动之外的人。

rely.sentenceEn: In primitive societies, people had to rely mostly on themselves to meet their personal needs.
rely.translationZh: 在原始社会中，人们大多只能依靠自己来满足个人需求。

rely.sentenceEn: Young adults rely on memory while older adults keep notes as a reminder.
rely.translationZh: 年轻人依赖记忆，而老年人则靠记笔记来提醒自己。

range.sentenceEn: Pet dogs can often readily understand a wide range of their owners' commands and gestures, but are these abilities inborn or are they exclusively learned through training?
range.translationZh: 宠物狗通常能轻松理解主人的各种指令和手势，但这些能力是天生的，还是完全通过训练习得的呢？
range.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

range.sentenceEn: According to the FAO, as much as 70 percent of all agricultural land globally is range land that can only be utilized as grazing land for ruminant livestock.
range.translationZh: 根据联合国粮农组织（FAO）的数据，全球高达70%的农业用地是牧场，只能用作反刍家畜的放牧地。

range.sentenceEn: The debate centers around a system developed by Monteiro and colleagues that classifies foods by their degree of industrial processing, ranging from unprocessed to ultra-processed.
range.translationZh: 这场争论围绕着由Monteiro及其同事开发的一个系统展开，该系统根据食品的工业加工程度对其进行分类，范围从非加工食品到超加工食品。
range.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

range.sentenceEn: In just the past few years, the peak childbearing age range for American women has advanced from that of 25-29 to that of 30-34.
range.translationZh: 在过去短短几年间，美国女性的生育高峰年龄段已从25-29岁提前至30-34岁。
range.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

range.sentenceEn: However, our beliefs on most topics are in the moderate range , and as we go about our daily lives reading informative material, these intriguing findings suggest we are mostly ignorant of how what we just read has updated and altered our own position.
range.translationZh: 然而，我们对大多数话题的看法都处于温和范围，而当我们在日常生活中阅读信息性材料时，这些有趣的研究结果表明，我们大多不知道刚刚阅读的内容如何更新和改变了我们自己的立场。
range.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

range.sentenceEn: A laboratory and test range was already set up there.
range.translationZh: 他在那里建立了一个实验室和试验场。

resident.sentenceEn: One study found that people here are less willing to volunteer to help strangers than those residents of other U.S. cities.
resident.translationZh: 一项研究发现，与美国其他城市的居民相比，这里的人们不太愿意主动帮助陌生人。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

resident.sentenceEn: Ask a resident of the city and they are likely to agree that saving time on the road is well worth it.
resident.translationZh: 如果你问这座城市的居民，他们很可能会认同：能节省路上的时间是非常值得的。

resident.sentenceEn: Kim also conducted a survey of 3,000 US residents .
resident.translationZh: 金还对3000名美国居民进行了一项调查。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

resident.sentenceEn: M: The achievement belongs to all the residents of Berkton.
resident.translationZh: 男：这项成就属于伯克顿的所有居民。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

resident.sentenceEn: What did one study find about Bostonians compared with residents of other U.S. cities?
resident.translationZh: 有一项研究发现波士顿人与美国其他城市居民相比有什么不同？

resident.sentenceEn: The majority of residents lived in harmony with their neighbours.
resident.translationZh: 大多数居民与邻居和睦相处。

recommend.sentenceEn: The WHO recommends establishing institutions that facilitate community participation—educational programs and interventions that provide skills for promoting mental wellbeing.
recommend.translationZh: 世界卫生组织建议建立促进社区参与的机构——提供促进心理健康技能的教育项目和干预措施。
recommend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

recommend.sentenceEn: Soon when you log into a restaurant app, it will be able to use your data and purchasing history to recommend dishes to you — factoring in everything from the weather to, if you are ordering at a screen that can read your face, your mood.
recommend.translationZh: 不久之后，当你登录餐厅应用时，系统将能利用你的个人数据和购买历史为你推荐菜肴——它会综合考虑从天气状况到你当前心情的所有因素，如果你是在一个具备面部识别功能的屏幕前下单，系统甚至能读懂你的情绪。

recommend.sentenceEn: In all cases, I recommend describing your situation and following up with a question like: "How would you manage this situation?"
recommend.translationZh: 无论在什么情况下，我都建议你先描述自己的处境，然后接着问一句：“如果是你，你会如何处理这种情况？”

recommend.sentenceEn: In contrast, NASA's sealed experiment recommended one pot plant per 100 square feet.
recommend.translationZh: 相比之下，美国国家航空航天局（NASA）的密封实验建议每100平方英尺放置一盆植物。
recommend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

recommend.sentenceEn: What does the speaker recommend in this talk?
recommend.translationZh: 演讲者在这次讲话中推荐了什么？

recommend.sentenceEn: They are less likely to choose dishes recommended by chefs.
recommend.translationZh: 他们不太可能选择厨师推荐的菜品。

represent.sentenceEn: That is very different from claiming that livestock represents as much as or more than transportation.
represent.translationZh: 这与声称畜牧业排放等同于甚至超过交通运输排放的说法截然不同。

represent.sentenceEn: All of agriculture accounted for a total of 9 percent, but all of animal agriculture contributes less than half of this amount, representing 3.9 percent of the total greenhouse emission in the U.S.
represent.translationZh: 农业整体占总量的9%，而畜牧业仅占其中不到一半，相当于美国温室气体总排放量的3.9%。

represent.sentenceEn: This statistic represents a flood of issues we've failed to confront as a nation.
represent.translationZh: 这项统计数据表明，我们作为一个国家未能正视的问题正滚滚而来。
represent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

represent.sentenceEn: This is because variability will represent the real world better, including atypical(非典型的) examples.
represent.translationZh: 这是因为可变性能更好地反映现实世界，包括那些非典型的例子。
represent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

represent.sentenceEn: What does the man say about some people he represents ?
represent.translationZh: 这位男士对他所代表的一些人有何评价？

represent.sentenceEn: It represents a good example of a major industrialized country promoting green energy.
represent.translationZh: 它是主要工业化国家推广绿色能源的一个良好范例。

reading.sentenceEn: Free tutoring, homework help programs, and summer reading programs for kids and teens help bridge the economic divide that impacts students' academic performance.
reading.translationZh: 为儿童和青少年提供的免费辅导、作业帮助项目和暑期阅读计划，有助于弥合影响学生学业表现的经济鸿沟。

reading.sentenceEn: Annual summer reading programs also have a positive impact on student performance and, according to a 2010 study conducted by Dominican University's Graduate School of Library and Information Science, students' reading skills get a boost from these popular nationwide events.
reading.translationZh: 年度暑期阅读计划对学生表现也有积极影响。根据多米尼加大学图书馆与信息科学研究生院2010年的一项研究，这些在全国范围内广受欢迎的活动有助于提高学生的阅读能力。

reading.sentenceEn: Reading with a young child is important.
reading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

reading.sentenceEn: In his new book, The Self Delusion, Professor Tom Oliver, a researcher in the Ecology and Evolution group at the University of Reading , argues there is no such thing as "self", and not even our bodies are truly "us".
reading.translationZh: 雷丁大学生态与进化研究组的研究员汤姆·奥利弗教授在其新书《自我错觉》中提出，所谓的“自我”并不存在，甚至我们的身体也并非真正的“我们”。
reading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

reading.sentenceEn: What did some American researchers find about students' reading comprehension in the presence of background noise?
reading.translationZh: 一些美国研究人员关于学生在有背景噪音的情况下的阅读理解有什么发现？

reading.sentenceEn: Parents differed from children in reading behavior.
reading.translationZh: 父母与子女在阅读行为上存在差异。

reward.sentenceEn: Rather than focusing on how far you've gone toward your goal, think about how you can reward yourself for the progress you've made.
reward.translationZh: 与其关注距离目标还有多远，不如想想如何奖励自己所取得的进步。
你的大脑会对奖励做出反应。

reward.sentenceEn: The basal ganglia, the brain region linked to our performance of habits, is most active at the beginning of a behavior, when the habit is cued, and at the end, when it's rewarded .
reward.translationZh: 基底神经节是与我们习惯执行相关的大脑区域，它在行为开始时（习惯被触发时）和结束时（获得奖励时）最为活跃。

reward.sentenceEn: Whatever your reward , it has to be more than just the activity itself to get you going.
reward.translationZh: 无论你的奖励是什么，它都必须不仅仅是活动本身，才能激励你行动起来。

reward.sentenceEn: In saying this, Wooden sought to promote purely generous acts, as opposed to those performed with an expectation of reward .
reward.translationZh: 通过这句话，伍登旨在倡导纯粹的慷慨行为，而非那些期望获得回报的行为。

reward.sentenceEn: They often get rewarded instead of being punished.
reward.translationZh: 这些角色往往会得到奖赏，而非受到惩罚。

recognize.sentenceEn: Only a few animals, such as humans, apes, dolphins and some birds, can recognize themselves in a mirror.
recognize.translationZh: 只有人类、猿类、海豚和部分鸟类等少数几种动物能够识别镜子里的自己。
recognize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

recognize.sentenceEn: It's also really important to recognize the way young people want to balance their work life with their personal life.
recognize.translationZh: 意识到年轻人希望平衡工作与生活的这种需求也至关重要。
recognize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

recognize.sentenceEn: For example, Ryan recognized she had developed various new skills and leadership capabilities from leading the design project.
recognize.translationZh: 例如，瑞安意识到她在领导设计项目的过程中，培养了各种新技能并提升了领导力。

recognize.sentenceEn: These findings suggest that ducklings use abstract relationships between sensory inputs like color, shape, sounds and odor to recognize their mothers, said Dr. Kacelnik.
recognize.translationZh: 卡塞尔尼克博士表示，这些发现表明，小鸭会利用颜色、形状、声音和气味等感官输入之间的抽象关系来识别自己的母亲。
recognize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

recognize.sentenceEn: For example, the researchers noted that both dogs and cats are known to be able to recognize and differentiate human voices.
recognize.translationZh: 例如，研究人员指出，狗和猫都能识别并区分人类的声音，这是众所周知的。
recognize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

recognize.sentenceEn: They could readily recognize their owner simply by looking.
recognize.translationZh: 它们仅通过观察就能轻易认出自己的主人。

replace.sentenceEn: However, some experts think that apps cannot replace human personal trainers.
replace.translationZh: 然而，一些专家认为应用程序无法取代人类私人教练。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第16句

replace.sentenceEn: By presenting consumers with algorithmically selected choices of what to watch, read, stream and visit next, companies are replacing human taste with machine taste.
replace.translationZh: 公司通过向消费者提供算法筛选的下一个观看、阅读、流媒体内容和访问地点的选择，正在用机器品味取代人类品味。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

replace.sentenceEn: These are areas where algorithmic(算法的) prescription is replacing human judgment, and so people who might have had the chance to develop practical judgment in these areas no longer will.
replace.translationZh: 这些领域正逐步由算法指令取代人类判断，因此原本可能在这些领域培养实际判断力的人们将不再有这样的机会。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

replace.sentenceEn: "Over the last 50 years, public interest and civic responsibility have been progressively eroded," they write, " replaced by a focus on self-interest and competition in a supposedly free and open marketplace."
replace.translationZh: 他们写道：“在过去50年中，公共利益和公民责任感逐渐被侵蚀，取而代之的是在所谓自由开放的市场中对个人利益和竞争的关注。”

replace.sentenceEn: One should introduce something new to replace an old habit instead of simply kicking it.
replace.translationZh: 要改掉旧习惯，应该用新习惯来替代，而不是简单地戒掉。

replace.sentenceEn: There seem to be no other options available to replace it.
replace.translationZh: 但它似乎缺乏明显的替代方案。

responsible.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, the agency's initial claim that livestock was responsible for the lion's share of world greenhouse gas emissions had already received wide coverage.
responsible.translationZh: 不幸的是，该机构最初声称畜牧业是全球温室气体排放的主要来源，这一说法已得到广泛报道。

responsible.sentenceEn: Another study found that the distinctive features of Mozart's music trigger parts of the brain that are responsible for high-level mental functions.
responsible.translationZh: 另一项研究发现，莫扎特音乐的独特特征会激活大脑中负责高级心理功能的部分。
responsible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

responsible.sentenceEn: The food sector is already responsible for nearly a third of global greenhouse gas emissions.
responsible.translationZh: 食品行业已占全球温室气体排放量的近三分之一。

responsible.sentenceEn: A scent is a chemical particle that floats in through the nose and into the region of the brain responsible for smell, where the sensation is first processed into a form that the brain can read.
responsible.translationZh: 气味是一种化学微粒，它通过鼻子进入大脑中负责嗅觉的区域，在那里，这种感觉首先被处理成大脑能够识别的形式。
responsible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

responsible.sentenceEn: The allegation that farm animals produce the world's largest portion of greenhouse gases is responsible for meat's bad reputation.
responsible.translationZh: 关于农场动物产生全球最大份额温室气体的指控，是肉类声名狼藉的原因。

responsible.sentenceEn: Schools as well as families should be held responsible for out-of-school crises.
responsible.translationZh: 学校和家庭都应对校外危机负责。

related.sentenceEn: A 2020 report by Citi indicated that "Black students could have increased their lifetime incomes $90 – $113 billion" if equity issues related to higher education had been adequately addressed over the past two decades.
related.translationZh: 花旗银行 2020 年的一份报告指出，如果过去二十年里与高等教育相关的公平问题能够得到妥善解决，“黑人学生的终身收入本可以增加 900 亿至 1130 亿美元”。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

related.sentenceEn: Accent is not a synonym for dialect, but it's related .
related.translationZh: 口音并不等同于方言，但两者之间确实存在关联。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

related.sentenceEn: They also rated the extent to which they believed success in life is related to various internal factors (such as ambition) and external factors (such as family wealth).
related.translationZh: 他们还对自己认为人生成功与各种内部因素（如雄心壮志）和外部因素（如家庭财富）相关的程度进行了评分。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

related.sentenceEn: The idea that we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality, is categorically false.
related.translationZh: 认为人有左脑主导和右脑主导之分，且这与性格有关的观点是完全错误的。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

related.sentenceEn: Researchers reviewed all the evidence published related to dietary diversity and saw a correlation between dietary diversity and a greater intake of both healthy and unhealthy foods.
related.translationZh: 研究人员回顾了所有已发表的与饮食多样性相关的证据，发现饮食多样性与健康食品和不健康食品摄入量的增加均存在相关性。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

related.sentenceEn: They are rarely in control of many things related to their work.
related.translationZh: 他们很少能掌控与工作相关的许多事情。

release.sentenceEn: The Urban Libraries Council released a report detailing the unique ways in which libraries can further sustainability at the local level.
release.translationZh: 城市图书馆理事会发布了一份报告，详细阐述了图书馆在地方层面促进可持续发展的独特方式。

release.sentenceEn: But cows, sheep and other ruminant(反刍的) animals can break cellulose down and release the solar energy contained in this vast resource.
release.translationZh: 但牛、羊和其他反刍动物能够分解纤维素，并释放这一巨大资源中蕴含的太阳能。

release.sentenceEn: Carrying the hurt or anger of an offense leads the body to release stress chemicals.
release.translationZh: 背负着伤害或因冒犯而产生的愤怒会导致身体释放压力化学物质。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

release.sentenceEn: Forgiveness is the release of resentment or anger.
release.translationZh: 宽恕是对怨恨或愤怒的释放。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

release.sentenceEn: American colleges and universities are using 64 percent less coal than they did a decade ago, burning 700,000 tons last year, down from 2 million tons in 2008, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in a report released yesterday.
release.translationZh: 美国能源信息署（EIA）在昨日发布的一份报告中指出，美国高校的煤炭使用量较十年前减少了64%，去年燃煤量为70万吨，低于2008年的200万吨。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

release.sentenceEn: Smash the toys to release their bottled-up resentments.
release.translationZh: 打碎玩具来释放他们压抑的怨气。

relevant.sentenceEn: When a person tries to access a memory, their brains quickly examine everything stored in it to find the relevant information.
relevant.translationZh: 当一个人试图回忆某段记忆时，他们的大脑会迅速检查存储的所有信息以找到相关内容。
relevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

relevant.sentenceEn: Researchers Tarek Amer, Jordana Wynn and Lynn Hasher looked at several behavioral and brain imaging studies, which show that older adults have difficulty suppressing information that is no longer relevant and that when searching for a specific memory, they often retrieve other, irrelevant memories along with it.
relevant.translationZh: 研究人员塔里克·阿米尔、乔丹娜·韦恩和林恩·哈舍查看了几项行为和脑成像研究，这些研究表明，老年人难以抑制不再相关的信息，并且在搜索特定记忆时，他们往往会同时检索到其他不相关的记忆。
relevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

relevant.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
relevant.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

relevant.sentenceEn: I think the thing that excites me most about my research is that it feels real and relevant .
relevant.translationZh: 我觉得我的研究最让我兴奋的一点是，它感觉真实且有实际意义。
relevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

relevant.sentenceEn: Lots of academics are probably very excited about their research, but it might not be that relevant to those around them.
relevant.translationZh: 许多学者或许对自己的研究感到非常兴奋，但这些研究可能与周围人的关联不大。
relevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

relatively.sentenceEn: Yet, relatively little research has explored how young children learn what's worth the effort.
relatively.translationZh: 然而，关于幼儿如何学会判断什么事情值得付出努力的研究相对较少。
relatively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

relatively.sentenceEn: A snob is anyone who takes a relatively small part of us and uses it to come to a rigid conclusion about how much of their attention we deserve.
relatively.translationZh: 势利小人就是那种只取我们身上相对微不足道的某一点，就武断地判定我们值得他们投入多少关注的人。
relatively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

relatively.sentenceEn: But nevertheless, this is a relatively close distance, close enough for people to observe in good detail through a telescope.
relatively.translationZh: 但无论如何，这是一个相对较近的距离，近到人们可以通过望远镜进行详细观测。
relatively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

relatively.sentenceEn: In about 10 years, Berkton has gone from a relatively unheard-of sleepy village to a must-see destination.
relatively.translationZh: 在大约十年的时间里，伯克顿已从一个相对默默无闻的宁静村庄发展成为必游之地。
relatively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

relatively.sentenceEn: Those who are shrewd and have got loans from the bank become relatively rich by selling their purchased home at a price several folds higher.
relatively.translationZh: 那些精明且从银行获得贷款的人，通过以数倍高价出售所购房产而变得相对富有。
relatively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

relatively.sentenceEn: It was relatively unknown to the outside.

reserve.sentenceEn: That's given Boston a sense of clannishness and reserve , he thinks.
reserve.translationZh: 他认为，这使得波士顿人具有一种抱团排外且内敛保守的特质。
reserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

reserve.sentenceEn: Federal Reserve data reveals that the highest-income 40 percent of households owe approximately 60 percent of outstanding student debt, while the lowest 40 percent owe just under 20 percent.
reserve.translationZh: 美联储数据显示，收入最高的40%家庭欠下了约60%的未偿还学生债务，而收入最低的40%家庭仅欠下不到20%。
reserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

reserve.sentenceEn: Today, the American dollar bill is a product of the Federal Reserve , and is issued from the twelve Federal Reserve banks around the United States.
reserve.translationZh: 如今，美元纸币是美联储的产物，由美国各地的十二家联邦储备银行发行。
reserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

reserve.sentenceEn: Hugh Possingham, director of the Centre of Excellence for Environmental Decisions at the University of Queensland, points out that little more than half of the Coral Sea reserve is proposed as "no take" area, in which all fishing would be banned.
reserve.translationZh: 昆士兰大学环境决策卓越中心主任休·波辛厄姆指出，珊瑚海保护区中仅有略超过一半的区域被提议设为"禁捕区"，在这些区域内所有捕鱼活动都将被禁止。
reserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reserve.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the Federal Reserve data?
reserve.translationZh: 我们能从美联储的数据中了解到什么？

reserve.sentenceEn: They should be reserved for urgent communication.
reserve.translationZh: 电子邮件应留作紧急沟通之用。

retail.sentenceEn: In fact, despite the demographic shift, retail spending on the holiday appears to be rising.
retail.translationZh: 事实上，尽管人口结构发生了变化，节日零售支出似乎仍在上升。
retail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

retail.sentenceEn: Tech giants are increasingly assuming powerful positions in banking, finance, advertising, retail , and other markets that force smaller businesses to rely on their platforms to reach customers.
retail.translationZh: 科技巨头正日益在银行、金融、广告、零售及其他市场占据强势地位，这迫使小型企业不得不依赖它们的平台来接触客户。
retail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

retail.sentenceEn: Plumbers and retail workers will be paying for the degrees of doctors and lawyers.
retail.translationZh: 水管工和零售店员将为医生和律师的学位买单。
retail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

retail.sentenceEn: The rise of the mobile phone has recently added a new level of complexity to the process of retail reinvention.
retail.translationZh: 近年来，移动电话的兴起为零售业的转型过程增添了新的复杂层面。

retail.sentenceEn: What might be one explanation for the rise in retail spending on Mother's Day?
retail.translationZh: 母亲节零售支出增加的一个可能解释是什么？

retail.sentenceEn: Plumbers and retail workers will have a chance of becoming professionals.
retail.translationZh: 水管工和零售店员将有机会成为专业人士。

recover.sentenceEn: Pesticide use also decreases the life in soil, hampering the ability of soils to absorb carbon or retain water and thus reducing campuses' ability to recover quickly from climate-related extreme weather events like droughts and floods.
recover.translationZh: 农药的使用还会减少土壤中的生物活性，削弱土壤吸收碳和保持水分的能力，从而降低校园从干旱和洪水等气候相关极端天气事件中快速恢复的能力。
recover.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

recover.sentenceEn: Researchers believe that the calming sounds of classical music may help your heart recover from stress.
recover.translationZh: 研究人员认为，古典音乐的舒缓声音可能有助于心脏从压力中恢复。
recover.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

recover.sentenceEn: "Not enough time to transition in a non-MRS situation to get anything done, and in an MRS situation, not quite enough time to recover for the next meeting," says researcher Joseph Allen.
recover.translationZh: 研究员约瑟夫·艾伦表示：“在非MRS情况下，没有足够的时间进行过渡来完成任何事情；而在MRS情况下，又没有足够的时间为下一次会议恢复精力。”

recover.sentenceEn: In the case of office meetings, where some of employees' most valuable resources are their focus, alertness and motivation, this can mean an abrupt halt in productivity as they take time to recover .
recover.translationZh: 就办公室会议而言，员工最宝贵的资源包括专注力、警觉性和积极性，这种干扰可能意味着生产力突然中断，因为他们需要时间恢复。

recover.sentenceEn: Electronic products contain valuable metals that could be recovered .
recover.translationZh: 电子产品含有可回收利用的贵重金属。

recovery.sentenceEn: Meeting recovery syndrome is a concept that should be familiar to almost anyone who has held a formal job.
recovery.translationZh: 会议恢复期综合征是几乎所有有过正式工作经历的人都应该熟悉的概念。

recovery.sentenceEn: The result is not only hundreds of billions of wasted dollars, but an annoyance of what organisational psychologists call "meeting recovery syndrome (MRS)": time spent cooling off and regaining focus after a useless meeting.
recovery.translationZh: 其结果不仅是数千亿美元的资金浪费，还会引发组织心理学家所说的“会议恢复综合症(MRS)”：在一场无用的会议后，人们需要时间冷静下来并重新集中注意力。

recovery.sentenceEn: If you run to the office kitchen to get some relief with colleagues after a frustrating meeting, you're likely experiencing meeting recovery syndrome.
recovery.translationZh: 如果一场令人沮丧的会议后，你跑到办公室厨房和同事们一起放松一下，那么你很可能正在经历会议恢复综合征。

recovery.sentenceEn: As simple as it sounds, finding a personal happy place, going there and then coming straight back to work might be key to facilitating recovery .
recovery.translationZh: 听起来简单，但找到一个能让自己开心的地方，去那里待一会儿，然后马上回到工作中，这或许是促进恢复的关键。

recovery.sentenceEn: Recovery may not take place even if one seems to have stopped working.
recovery.translationZh: 即使一个人看似已经停止工作，恢复也未必会发生。

recovery.sentenceEn: Blame your worthless workdays on meeting recovery syndrome
recovery.translationZh: 把你毫无价值的工作日归咎于会议恢复期综合征

rural.sentenceEn: W: Over the summer, I traveled through rural mountain villages throughout Asia in search of handicrafts to decorate my new studio with.
rural.translationZh: 女：整个夏天，我游历了亚洲各地的偏远山村，寻找手工艺品来装饰我的新工作室。
rural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

rural.sentenceEn: As I was born poor and in the countryside, the simple rural life seldom loses its appeal to me, but as my station changes, I have an opportunity to mingle with the newly rich, an experience which has revolutionized my view of lifestyle.
rural.translationZh: 我出身贫寒，长在农村，简单的田园生活对我始终有着特殊的吸引力。然而，随着社会地位的变化，我有机会接触到新富阶层，这段经历彻底改变了我对生活方式的看法。
rural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

rural.sentenceEn: Industrialisation brought an increase in divisions of labour, changing social links between rural people.
rural.translationZh: 工业化加剧了劳动分工，改变了农村人口之间的社会联系。
rural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

rural.sentenceEn: Rural dwellers also use more energy maintaining their mostly detached buildings.
rural.translationZh: 农村居民在维护其大多为独立式的建筑时也消耗更多能源。
rural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

rural.sentenceEn: What does the author think of the rural lifestyle?
rural.translationZh: 作者如何看待乡村生活方式？

rural.sentenceEn: Learn from the designs of the Asian rural mountain villagers.
rural.translationZh: 向亚洲山区村民的设计学习

remove.sentenceEn: Removing animals from U.S. agriculture would lower national greenhouse gas emissions to a small degree, but it would also make it harder to meet people's nutritional requirements.
remove.translationZh: 将动物从美国农业中移除会在一定程度上降低国家温室气体排放，但同时也会使满足人们的营养需求变得更加困难。

remove.sentenceEn: Their method was able to remove 99% of pollutants.
remove.translationZh: 他们的方法能够去除99%的污染物。
remove.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

remove.sentenceEn: The fish in our study never attempted to remove the marks when no mirror was present or when the marks were just placed on the mirror.
remove.translationZh: 在我们的研究中，当没有镜子或标记仅贴在镜面上时，这些鱼从未尝试过去除身上的标记。
remove.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

remove.sentenceEn: Similarly, if you're looking for love advice, ask someone removed from the ups and downs of your relationship instead of relying only on your best friend.
remove.translationZh: 同样，如果你在寻求情感建议，与其只依赖最好的朋友，不如去请教那些置身于你的感情波动之外的人。

remove.sentenceEn: What is the final reason the speaker gives for removing shoes before entering a house?
remove.translationZh: 演讲者给出的进屋前脱鞋的最后一个理由是什么？

remove.sentenceEn: Remove aggressive obstacles in the way.

regular.sentenceEn: But as long as you have regular social contact, you are choosing solitude rather than being forced into it, you have at least a few good friends and your solitude is good for your well-being or productivity, there's no point agonising over how to fit a square personality into a round hole.
regular.translationZh: 但只要你有正常的社交往来，是主动选择独处而非被迫独处，至少有几个好朋友，并且这种独处对你的身心健康或工作效率有益，那么就没必要纠结如何把方方正正的性格硬塞进圆洞里了。

regular.sentenceEn: By now, it is generally accepted that regular exercise comes with an assortment of health benefits for people who maintain the habit over time.
regular.translationZh: 目前，人们普遍公认，长期坚持规律运动能为人体健康带来诸多益处。
regular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

regular.sentenceEn: Whether classical music is something that you listen to on a regular basis or not, it wouldn't hurt to take time out of your day to listen to music that you find soothing.
regular.translationZh: 无论你是否经常听古典音乐，每天抽出一点时间听听让你感到舒缓的音乐总是有益无害的。
regular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

regular.sentenceEn: A lot of headlines about moons are just ridiculous (you do not need to be particularly excited about a blue moon, it just looks like a regular full moon), but you should definitely roll out of bed to look at a blood moon if one is going to be visible in your region, even though they're just lunar eclipses and not evidence of bloody battles between the sky gods.
regular.translationZh: 许多关于月亮的新闻标题都很荒谬（你不必对蓝月亮特别兴奋，它看起来就像普通的满月），但如果你的地区能看到血月，你绝对应该起床去看看，尽管它们只是月食，并非天空诸神之间血腥战斗的证据。

regular.sentenceEn: There are probably loads of folks who walk around pretending they totally know why that thing in the sky seems to get bigger and smaller at regular intervals but who totally do not.
regular.translationZh: 可能有很多人整天装作完全知道为什么天上那个东西似乎会定期变大变小，但他们其实根本不知道。

regular.sentenceEn: She made regular trips to Asian countries.
regular.translationZh: 她定期前往亚洲国家旅行。

retailer.sentenceEn: In a statement, the high street retailer defended itself by saying that the burnt clothing had failed safety tests: "The products to which the media are referring have been tested in external laboratories. The test results show that one of the products is mold infested and the other product contains levels of lead that are too high. Those products have rightly been stopped in accordance with our safety routines."
retailer.translationZh: 这家高街零售商在一份声明中为自己辩护称，被烧毁的服装未通过安全测试：“媒体所指的产品已在外部实验室进行了检测。测试结果显示，其中一款产品滋生霉菌，另一款产品铅含量过高。根据我们的安全程序，这些产品被正确地拦截处理。”

retailer.sentenceEn: So far, the main thing many large retailers have done in response to all this is to open online stores, so people will come to them directly rather than to Amazon and its smaller online rivals.
retailer.translationZh: 迄今为止，面对这一切，许多大型零售商的主要应对措施是开设网店，以便让消费者直接访问他们，而非转向亚马逊及其规模较小的在线竞争对手。

retailer.sentenceEn: The dot-com bust discredited most predictions of that sort and in the years that followed, conventional retailers ' confidence in the future increased as Census continued to report weak online sales.
retailer.translationZh: 互联网泡沫的破裂使这类预测大多失去了可信度。在随后的几年里，随着人口普查局持续报告在线销售疲软，传统零售商对未来的信心逐渐增强。

retailer.sentenceEn: The big questions are which, if any, of the large traditional retailers will still be on the scene in a decade or two because they have successfully reinvented themselves, which new players will operate busy stores on Main Streets and maybe even in shopping malls, and how the shopping and buying experience will have changed in each retail category.
retailer.translationZh: 核心问题在于：哪些大型传统零售商（如果有的话）能够通过成功转型在未来十年或二十年后依然屹立不倒；哪些新兴力量将在商业街甚至购物中心开设客流兴旺的店铺；以及各类零售业态中的购物体验将发生怎样的变化。

retailer.sentenceEn: Although online retailing has existed for some twenty years, nearly half of the internet retailers still fail to receive satisfactory feedback from consumers, according to a recent survey.
retailer.translationZh: 尽管在线零售已存在约二十年，但根据最近的一项研究，近半数的互联网零售商仍未能获得消费者的满意评价。

retailer.sentenceEn: The Best Retailers Combine Bricks and Clicks
retailer.translationZh: 最佳零售商：线上线下融合之道

recognition.sentenceEn: Acting out of solidarity means supporting and standing up for each other — in recognition that one's fate is in the fate of the other.
recognition.translationZh: 以团结的精神行事意味着相互支持和挺身而出——因为我们意识到，彼此的命运休戚与共。
recognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第7句

recognition.sentenceEn: "For example, face recognition is affected by whether people grew up in a small community or in a larger community. Exposure to fewer faces during childhood is associated with diminished face memory."
recognition.translationZh: 例如，人脸识别会受到人们成长于小社区还是大社区的影响。童年时期接触的面孔较少与面孔记忆力下降有关。
recognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

recognition.sentenceEn: But the Paris Conference nevertheless marked a historic step toward the recognition of the need for action on climate change, the cutting of carbon emissions, and world cooperation.
recognition.translationZh: 但巴黎气候大会仍然标志着人类在认识气候变化应对必要性、削减碳排放以及开展全球合作方面迈出了历史性的一步。

recognition.sentenceEn: The late 19th and early 20th century saw an increasing recognition that forests serve as habitats for countless animal and plant species that all rely on each other.
recognition.translationZh: 19世纪末20世纪初，人们逐渐认识到森林是无数动植物物种的栖息地，而这些物种都相互依存。

recognition.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about face recognition ?
recognition.translationZh: 这篇文章关于人脸识别说了什么？

recognition.sentenceEn: It wins recognition outside of Birmingham.
recognition.translationZh: 它在伯明翰之外也获得了认可。

rarely.sentenceEn: Further, under normal working conditions, managers rarely see the full effect of their employee development efforts.
rarely.translationZh: 此外，在正常工作条件下，管理者很少能看到其员工发展努力的全部效果。
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

rarely.sentenceEn: The study involved 750 people, half of whom frequently ate vegetarian food and half of whom rarely ate it.
rarely.translationZh: 这项研究涉及 750 人，其中一半人经常吃素食，另一半人则很少食用。
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

rarely.sentenceEn: At its core, success in changing and maintaining a behavior rarely occurs without the introduction of some sort of system.
rarely.translationZh: 从根本上讲，若不引入某种体系，改变和维持一种行为的成功往往难以实现。

rarely.sentenceEn: It sounds like the kind of thing that, for me personally, I would rarely use.
rarely.translationZh: 就我个人而言，这听起来像是我很少会用到的那种东西。
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

rarely.sentenceEn: Statements, like "beauty is in the eye of the beholder(观看者)", are rarely questioned.

rarely.sentenceEn: They are rarely in control of many things related to their work.

reader.sentenceEn: New moms connect at baby story-times; elderly people, often facing difficult life transitions, attend events and find that they make new friends; teenagers meet up in libraries' teen spaces after school; and readers discuss current events in the periodicals room.
reader.translationZh: 新手妈妈们通过婴儿故事会相互结识；老年人往往面临艰难的人生转折，他们参加活动并发现自己交到了新朋友；青少年放学后在图书馆的青少年专区相聚；读者们则在期刊阅览室讨论时事。

reader.sentenceEn: Take illustration for example: most readers don't care whether the graphic accompanying a magazine article was drawn by a person or a computer — they just want it to be relevant, new and perhaps entertaining.

reader.sentenceEn: This observation is bound to set Marxist alarm bells ringing in the minds of some readers , but it was first made by Alexis de Tocqueville in 1840.

reader.sentenceEn: For the first time since measurement began, Mississippi's pupils are now average readers , a remarkable achievement in such a poor state.
reader.translationZh: 自开始统计以来，密西西比州的学生首次达到了平均阅读水平，在这样一个贫困的州取得这样的成绩实属非凡。
reader.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

reader.sentenceEn: Why do ordinary readers find it difficult to access the results of researchers' studies?
reader.translationZh: 为什么普通读者难以获取研究人员的研究成果？

reader.translationZh: 要让读者相信她并非易事。

reputation.sentenceEn: Still, other cities with reputations for worse rudeness are trying hard to change their images.

reputation.sentenceEn: A healthy portion of meat's negative reputation centers on the assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide.

reputation.sentenceEn: "Archaeology has a terrible reputation for not publishing enough on its excavations(发掘) and finds," he says.
reputation.translationZh: 他说：“考古学在发掘和发现成果的发表方面做得远远不够，这一点名声很差。”

reputation.sentenceEn: Yet some of Cape Canaveral's most legendary attractions lie unseen, wedged under the sea's surface in mud and sand, for this part of the world has a reputation as a deadly ship trap.
reputation.translationZh: 然而，卡纳维拉尔角一些最具传奇色彩的景点却隐匿于海面之下，深陷泥砂之中——因为这片海域素有"船只死亡陷阱"之称。

reputation.sentenceEn: The allegation that farm animals produce the world's largest portion of greenhouse gases is responsible for meat's bad reputation .
reputation.translationZh: 关于农场动物产生全球最大份额温室气体的指控，是肉类声名狼藉的原因。

radical.sentenceEn: We must reevaluate the harm of radical , individual freedom.
radical.translationZh: 我们必须重新评估激进的个人自由所带来的危害。
radical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

radical.sentenceEn: Radical individualism elevates the freedom of the individual over the collective.
radical.translationZh: 激进的个人主义将个人自由置于集体利益之上。
radical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

radical.sentenceEn: There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken.
radical.translationZh: 若不采取根本性行动，这一严峻局面似乎无望得到改善。

radical.sentenceEn: The study concludes that without radical action the level of prosperity that millions of people in the developed world count on will be impossible to maintain or extend to poorer countries.
radical.translationZh: 该研究得出结论：如果不采取彻底行动，发达国家数百万人所依赖的繁荣水平将无法维持，也无法扩展到较贫穷国家。

radical.sentenceEn: What does the author advise people to do in their pursuit of radical individualism?
radical.translationZh: 作者建议人们在追求激进个人主义的过程中应该怎么做？

rapidly.sentenceEn: These, combined with a rapidly rising world population, give us plenty of compelling reasons to continue to work for greater efficiencies in animal agriculture.

rapidly.sentenceEn: Abundant research shows the harms of social isolation, considered a serious public health problem in countries that have rapidly ageing populations (though talk of a 'loneliness epidemic' may be exaggerated).

rapidly.sentenceEn: To achieve success, an organization must build a transformation program that will allow change to be rapidly pulled across its departments and throughout its layers.
rapidly.translationZh: 要取得成功，组织必须制定转型计划，以便变革能够迅速在各部门和各层级推行。
rapidly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

rapidly.sentenceEn: Invariably, over the next 10 years, jobs will go in conventional bricks-built restaurants, not least because automation will boost their rapidly growing rival: delivery.
rapidly.translationZh: 在未来的十年里，传统实体餐厅的岗位必将逐步缩减，这在很大程度上是因为自动化将助力其飞速成长的竞争对手：外卖行业。

rapidly.sentenceEn: "We are at a critical crossroads as a species where we must rapidly reform our mindsets and behaviour to act in less selfish ways," he said.
rapidly.translationZh: 他说：“作为一个物种，我们正处于关键的十字路口，必须迅速改变思维方式和行为模式，以更少自私的方式行事。”
rapidly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

regulation.sentenceEn: Dietary guidelines form the basis for nutrition advice and regulations around the world.
regulation.translationZh: 膳食指南构成了全球营养建议和法规的基础。
regulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

regulation.sentenceEn: Shortly thereafter, public initiatives and political campaigns led to strict regulations and new laws, including the Clean Air Act (1956).
regulation.translationZh: 此后不久，公众倡议和政治运动促成了严格的法规和新法律的出台，其中包括1956年的《清洁空气法案》。

regulation.sentenceEn: The emergence of the idea led to the rise of environmental agencies, regulations and environmental studies, and to environmental science as new, integrated academic disciplines.
regulation.translationZh: 这一理念的出现催生了环境机构、法规和环境研究的兴起，并促使环境科学成为一门新兴的综合性学科。

regulation.sentenceEn: The draft rules followed the surprise suspension of a $37 billion stock offering by billionaire Jack Ma's Ant Group Co., making clear that no company can evade the government's regulation .
regulation.translationZh: 该规则草案出台前，亿万富翁马云旗下的蚂蚁集团意外暂停了其370亿美元的股票发行，这清楚地表明没有任何公司可以逃避政府监管。
regulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

regulation.sentenceEn: Some people argue that the fact that different states have different regulations concerning medical services hinders the development of telemedicine.
regulation.translationZh: 一些人认为，各州对医疗服务的监管规定各不相同，这一事实阻碍了远程医疗的发展。

regulation.sentenceEn: They have imposed strict regulation over digital giants' advertising.
regulation.translationZh: 他们对数字巨头的广告业务实施了严格监管。

regardless.sentenceEn: Surveys revealed that working-class and first-generation college graduates, regardless of their career field, are more likely than their wealthier peers to end up in low-paying unskilled jobs when they pursue their passion.
regardless.translationZh: 调查显示，工薪阶层和第一代大学毕业生无论从事何种职业领域，当他们追求自己热爱的事业时，比家境更优渥的同龄人更有可能从事低薪的非技术性工作。
regardless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

regardless.sentenceEn: School attendance policies typically hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss, regardless of whether they were excused or unexcused absences.
regardless.translationZh: 学校出勤政策通常要求学校和家庭对儿童缺课天数负责，无论这些缺勤是有正当理由还是无正当理由。
regardless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

regardless.sentenceEn: In a time when education is increasingly expensive, public libraries provide information and educational opportunities free for all people, regardless of their socio-economic status.
regardless.translationZh: 在教育成本日益高昂的时代，公共图书馆为所有人提供免费的信息和教育机会，无论其社会经济地位如何。

regardless.sentenceEn: Health is an issue for everyone, regardless of their age, and what I'm trying to do is understand the factors that affect health and how we can improve the quality of life in people.
regardless.translationZh: 健康是每个人都面临的问题，无论年龄大小。我正在努力做的是了解影响健康的因素，以及我们如何提高人们的生活质量。
regardless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

regardless.sentenceEn: Regardless of the level of senior management commitment, unless key thought leaders at all levels embrace the change, the initiative will wither and die.
regardless.translationZh: 无论高层管理的承诺程度如何，除非各级关键思想领袖都接受变革，否则这一举措终将失败消亡。
regardless.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

regardless.sentenceEn: Resort to all means regardless of the consequences.

regularly.sentenceEn: By the early 1980s, workers regularly complained of skin rashes, sleeplessness, headaches, and allergies as they breathed in toxic chemicals from paints and plastics.
regularly.translationZh: 到20世纪80年代初，工人们在吸入油漆和塑料释放的有毒化学物质后，经常抱怨出现皮疹、失眠、头痛和过敏症状。
regularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

regularly.sentenceEn: Finally, they read a list of TV programmes and indicated which they regularly watched.
regularly.translationZh: 最后，他们阅读了一份电视节目清单，并指出了哪些是他们经常观看的。
regularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

regularly.sentenceEn: And while these programmes are regularly among the most-watched shows, news broadcasts—which paint a more realistic view of the economic hardship faced by millions of Americans—get a much smaller proportion of the viewership.
regularly.translationZh: 尽管这些节目常常位居收视率最高的节目之列，但新闻广播——它们更真实地展现了数百万美国人面临的经济困境——的观众比例却要小得多。
regularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

regularly.sentenceEn: There are likely lots of people who know absolutely nothing about why the moon appears to change its size regularly but act like they know.
regularly.translationZh: 很可能有很多人完全不知道月亮为什么看起来会有规律地改变大小，却装作自己很懂。

regularly.sentenceEn: They are regularly donated to charity organizations.
regularly.translationZh: 这些钱通常会捐赠给慈善机构。

revolution.sentenceEn: When shrinking municipal budgets combine with the nonstop technological revolution , public library services that focus on building communities face-to-face, inspiring and educating patrons about art, literature, and music, and helping patrons engage in civil discourse can seem old-fashioned.

revolution.sentenceEn: A more recent advocate of thoughtful and productive solitude is Susan Cain, author of *Quiet: The Power of Introverts in a World That Can't Stop Talking* and founder of Quiet Revolution , a company that promotes quiet and introvert-friendly workplaces.
revolution.translationZh: 苏珊·凯恩是近年来倡导深思熟虑且富有成效的独处生活的代表人物，她著有《安静：内向性格的竞争力》一书，并创立了“安静革命”组织——一家致力于推广安静且适合内向者的工作环境的公司。

revolution.sentenceEn: "We're urging Members of Parliament to ensure automation does not just benefit a wealthy few like previous industrial revolutions ."
revolution.translationZh: 我们正敦促国会议员确保自动化进程不会像之前的工业革命那样，仅仅让少数富人受益。

revolution.sentenceEn: This economy rests on a technological revolution of mobile phones and social media that makes it possible for corporations to target our attention with their content at every moment.
revolution.translationZh: 这种经济模式建立在手机和社交媒体的技术革命之上，这使得公司能够在每一刻都利用其内容来锁定我们的注意力。
revolution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

revolution.sentenceEn: High-yielding crops have occupied a dominant position in modern agriculture since the green revolution in the last century.
revolution.translationZh: 自上世纪绿色革命以来，高产作物在现代农业中一直占据主导地位。

revolution.sentenceEn: It is seeing an automation revolution .
revolution.translationZh: 西澳大利亚的沙漠地区正经历着一场自动化革命。

relative.sentenceEn: Use them to remove yourself from the love you have for this idea and consider your burn rate relative to growth plan, industry growth rates, and other factors that predict start-up success.

relative.sentenceEn: Despite the relative scarcity of research behind the subject, Hartman has taught herself many of the same tricks suggested in Mroz's study, and has come a long way since her days of being stuck with unnecessary meetings.

remote.sentenceEn: These partnerships enabled the mail to quickly follow migrants, helping knit together remote parts of the country.

remote.translationZh: 对于这些偏远岛屿的居民来说，最危险的事情是土地侵蚀。

remote.translationZh: 法齐拉住在孟加拉国北部一个偏远的河岛上。

remote.sentenceEn: Some children on the remote islands won't eat their meals because they are fed cheap junk food.

renewable.translationZh: 与此同时，那些成功实现可再生能源供电的国家，通常都得益于其非凡的水力发电能力。

rare.sentenceEn: Getting two blue moons a year is rare , but we have individual blue moons every few years.
rare.translationZh: 一年出现两次蓝月的情况很罕见，但每隔几年我们就会遇到一次蓝月。

rare.sentenceEn: The ongoing conservative civil war often degenerates into content-free tribal warfare, but trade is a rare exception.
rare.translationZh: 持续不断的保守派内战常常演变成缺乏实质内容的派系之争，但贸易问题却是一个罕见的例外。

rare.sentenceEn: It was not a rare occurrence that audiences behaved wildly while listening to classical music.

rare.sentenceEn: They are thrilled by a rare astronomic phenomenon.
rare.translationZh: 他们对这一罕见的天文现象感到非常兴奋。

recommendation.sentenceEn: While the mechanisms behind these associations are not fully understood, Monteiro argues that the existing evidence is sufficient to justify discouraging consumption of ultra-processed foods in dietary recommendations and government policies.
recommendation.translationZh: 虽然这些关联背后的机制尚未完全明确，但蒙泰罗认为现有证据已足以支持在膳食建议和政府政策中劝阻超加工食品消费。
