rank.translationZh: 目前，美国在政府中的女性代表比例方面位居世界第73位。
rank.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

rank.sentenceEn: According to a recent study, San Francisco ranks first in California for economic difference.
rank.translationZh: 根据最近的一项研究，旧金山的经济差距在加利福尼亚州位居首位。

rank.sentenceEn: American fourth graders rank 15th on the Progress in International Literacy Study, an international exam.
rank.translationZh: 在国际阅读素养进展研究（一项国际考试）中，美国四年级学生排名第15位。
rank.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

rank.sentenceEn: Defoe's masterpiece, which is often ranked as one of the world's greatest novels, provides a portrait of gratitude in action that is as timely and relevant today as it has ever been.
rank.translationZh: 笛福的这部杰作常被列为世界最伟大的小说之一，它描绘了感恩在生活中的实践，其现实意义和时代价值丝毫不减当年。

rank.sentenceEn: To test this, we asked workers to complete an online survey and rank how much time they spent cyberloafing, checking non-work emails and shopping.
rank.translationZh: 为了验证这一点，我们让员工完成一项在线调查，并对他们网络摸鱼、查看非工作邮件和购物所花费的时间进行评分。
rank.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

rank.sentenceEn: The US ranks first in the number of endangered languages.
rank.translationZh: 美国濒危语言数量位居世界第一。

react.sentenceEn: This will only work if you take the alarms seriously, so make sure you react as soon as you hear them.
react.translationZh: 这只有在你认真对待警报的情况下才会奏效，所以听到警报时一定要立即采取行动。
react.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

react.sentenceEn: It can be tempting in this situation to react harshly to the advice giver and to accuse them of being manipulative, but this approach might produce an undesired result.
react.translationZh: 在这种情况下，人们往往会忍不住对提建议的人恶语相向，并指责对方在操纵局面，但这种做法可能会产生适得其反的效果。
react.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

react.sentenceEn: This means simply that it is possible to observe ourselves having a craving, or a happy thought, or even a scary emotion, without reacting in the moment in a way that amplifies the feeling or sends the mind spiraling off into thinking about old memories or anticipating events.
react.translationZh: 简单来说，这意味着我们可以观察自己产生某种渴望、愉悦的念头，甚至是恐惧的情绪，而不会在当下立即做出反应，从而避免加剧这种感受，或让思绪陷入对往事的回忆以及对未来的忧虑中。
react.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

react.sentenceEn: However, just as it is possible to watch ourselves having an experience without reacting , it's possible to watch another person have an experience without getting tied up in reactivity and judgment.
react.translationZh: 然而，正如我们能够不带反应地观察自己的体验一样，我们也可以观察他人的体验，而不至于陷入连锁反应和评判之中。
react.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

react.sentenceEn: How is the advice giver likely to react to the rejection of their advice?
react.translationZh: 建议提供者在建议被拒绝时可能会有怎样的反应？

react.sentenceEn: They reacted quickly to moving objects.
react.translationZh: 它们对移动物体反应迅速。

reflection.sentenceEn: Solitude is a time for reflection , for thinking about things more deeply.
reflection.translationZh: 独处是反思的时刻，是深入思考事物的时刻。

reflection.sentenceEn: Solitude allows for the reflection and observation necessary for that creative process.
reflection.translationZh: 独处为创作过程提供了必要的反思与观察空间。

reflection.sentenceEn: And only these animals, capable of self-recognition, will attempt to remove marks placed on their skin after noticing them in the reflection .
reflection.translationZh: 只有这些具备自我识别能力的动物，在注意到镜中映像后，才会尝试清除掉涂抹在皮肤上的标记。
reflection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

reflection.sentenceEn: The colors of a rainbow are produced by the reflection and dispersion of light through water droplets(小滴) present in the atmosphere.
reflection.translationZh: 彩虹的颜色是由大气中的水滴对光线的反射和色散产生的。
reflection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

reflection.sentenceEn: The light waves change direction as they pass through the water droplets, resulting in two processes: reflection and refraction(折射).
reflection.translationZh: 光波穿过水滴时会改变方向，这产生了两个过程：反射和折射。
reflection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

reflection.sentenceEn: A variety of factors have conspired to rob us of time for reflection about ourselves and our lives.
reflection.translationZh: 多种因素共同作用，剥夺了我们反思自我和生活的时间。
reflection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

remind.sentenceEn: If it's something you'll be coming back to, like a project for work, make a note to remind yourself where you left off.
remind.translationZh: 如果你以后还会回过头来处理某些事情，比如工作项目，那么最好做个记录，提醒自己上次做到了哪里。
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

remind.sentenceEn: "This work reminds me to be in the present moment as I play my role in reducing herbicide use and keeping my campus safe and healthy," says Charlene.
remind.translationZh: 夏琳说：“这项工作提醒我，在为减少除草剂使用、保障校园安全健康贡献力量时，要活在当下。”
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

remind.sentenceEn: "This is a better strategy," they claim, than reminding consumers that a certain food is good for them.
remind.translationZh: 他们声称：“比起提醒消费者某种食物对健康有益，这是一种更好的策略。”
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

remind.sentenceEn: I was reminded of this again recently listening to an interview with Nicole Haddow, the author of Smashed Avocado, explaining how she cracked the property market at 31.
remind.translationZh: 最近，在听《牛油果吐司》作者妮可·哈多的访谈时，我再次想到了这一点。她在访谈中讲述了自己如何在31岁时成功进入房地产市场。
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

remind.sentenceEn: I am reminded of Abraham Lincoln's quote, "I don't like that man. I must get to know him better."
remind.translationZh: 这让我想起亚伯拉罕·林肯的名言：“我不喜欢那个人。我必须更好地了解他。”

remind.sentenceEn: Remind them of the distraction from mobile phones and social media.
remind.translationZh: 提醒他们手机和社交媒体带来的干扰。

requirement.sentenceEn: Removing animals from U.S. agriculture would lower national greenhouse gas emissions to a small degree, but it would also make it harder to meet people's nutritional requirements .
requirement.translationZh: 将动物从美国农业中移除会在一定程度上降低国家温室气体排放，但同时也会使满足人们的营养需求变得更加困难。

requirement.sentenceEn: Rural energy requirements result in higher carbon emissions per person than in the city, so it is actually irresponsible to endorse such a lifestyle choice.
requirement.translationZh: 农村地区的能源需求导致人均碳排放高于城市，因此推崇这种生活方式选择实际上是不负责任的。
requirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

requirement.sentenceEn: Arguments tend to place different requirements on people in different income brackets and exclude entirely people who are merely making ends meet.
requirement.translationZh: 这类论点往往对不同收入阶层的人提出不同要求，而那些仅能维持生计的人则完全被排除在外。
requirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

requirement.sentenceEn: I will group together all those arguments that place a moral requirement on people to give to charity, despite the fact that there is wide disagreement as to the extent of that moral requirement .
requirement.translationZh: 我将把所有认为人们在道德上有义务向慈善机构捐款的论点归为一类，尽管对于这种道德义务的程度存在广泛分歧。
requirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

requirement.sentenceEn: Tiny colleges are not the answer to all of our educational requirements , but they're an answer to one of our most basic educational necessities; the need to produce thoughtful, engaged, and compassionate human beings.
requirement.translationZh: 微型学院并非能满足我们所有的教育需求，但它们能满足我们最基本的教育需求之一：培养有思想、积极参与社会且富有同情心的人。

requirement.sentenceEn: They convey their requirements in a straightforward way.
requirement.translationZh: 他们以直接明了的方式传达期望。

respondent.sentenceEn: In a recent survey, nine out of ten respondents said they'd used their smartphone during their most recent social activity.
respondent.translationZh: 在最近的一项调查中，九成受访者表示他们在最近的一次社交活动中使用了智能手机。
respondent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

respondent.sentenceEn: When Yoon conducted the same survey 15 years later, only 10% of respondents reported a love of cooking, 45% said they hated it and 45% had mixed feelings.
respondent.translationZh: 15年后，当尹（Yoon）再次进行同样的调查时，只有10%的受访者表示热爱烹饪，45%的人表示讨厌烹饪，另有45%的人则表示心情复杂。
respondent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

respondent.sentenceEn: And when a drink that was lime flavor was colored orange, nearly half of respondents identified the flavor of the beverage as orange.
respondent.translationZh: 当一款青柠味饮料被染成橙色时，近半数受访者认为这款饮料是橙子味的。
respondent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

respondent.sentenceEn: In an initial study of more than 700 respondents , scholars from an American university analyzed the impact that friends, as opposed to family, have on self-esteem and well-being.
respondent.translationZh: 在一项针对700多名受访者的初步研究中，美国一所大学的学者分析了朋友（而非家人）对自尊和幸福感的影响。
respondent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

respondent.sentenceEn: The respondents had to rate the extent of their agreement.
respondent.translationZh: 受访者需要对自己的认同程度进行评分。
respondent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

respondent.sentenceEn: All respondents were afraid of making a high expense claim.
respondent.translationZh: 所有受访者都害怕提出高额费用报销申请。

retirement.sentenceEn: Spending above your means, spending instead of saving for retirement , spending in anticipation of becoming wealthy, makes you a slave to the paycheck.
retirement.translationZh: 支出超过自身财力、只顾眼前消费而不储蓄退休金、为了幻想中的暴富而挥霍无度——这些行为会让你沦为薪水的奴隶。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

retirement.sentenceEn: I haven't visited here since your predecessor's retirement function.
retirement.translationZh: 自从您前任的退休典礼后，我就没来过这里了。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

retirement.sentenceEn: The largest proportion should be invested in retirement plans, either through your employer or privately.
retirement.translationZh: 最大比例的资金应用于退休计划投资，可以通过雇主进行，也可以自行进行。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

retirement.sentenceEn: So Brookdale, the country's largest owner of retirement communities, has been inviting a few select entrepreneurs just to move in for a few days, show off their products and hear what the residents have to say.
retirement.translationZh: 因此，美国最大的退休社区运营商布鲁克代尔集团开始邀请一些经过筛选的企业家入住几天，展示他们的产品，并听取居民的意见。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

retirement.sentenceEn: After her retirement , the author has decided to set up a tiny college in her hometown.
retirement.translationZh: 退休后，作者决定在家乡创办一所小型学院。

retirement.sentenceEn: It was displayed at a retirement party.
retirement.translationZh: 它曾在一场退休派对上展出过。

rocket.sentenceEn: Nearly 1.5 million visitors flock here every year to watch rockets , spacecraft, and satellites blast off into the solar system from Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex.
rocket.translationZh: 每年有近150万游客涌向这里，在肯尼迪航天中心游客综合区观看火箭、航天器和卫星发射升空，飞向太阳系。

rocket.sentenceEn: Other rocket enthusiasts also raised funds for him.
rocket.translationZh: 其他火箭爱好者也为他筹集了资金。
rocket.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

rocket.sentenceEn: At age 27, Goddard published his first book in which he hypothesized that a rocket launched from Earth could reach the Moon.
rocket.translationZh: 27岁时，戈达德出版了他的第一本书，在书中他提出假设：从地球发射的火箭可以抵达月球。
rocket.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

rocket.sentenceEn: Over time, Goddard's rocket grew more sophisticated and included the installation of instruments.
rocket.translationZh: 随着时间的推移，戈达德的火箭变得更加精密复杂，并开始配备各种仪器。
rocket.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

rocket.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about Goddard's first rocket voyage?
rocket.translationZh: 关于戈达德的首次火箭飞行，文章说了什么？

rocket.sentenceEn: It was of great significance to rocket science.
rocket.translationZh: 尽管如此，这仍是火箭科学史上的一个里程碑。

recall.sentenceEn: It happened years ago, and it's a measure of the forgettable nature of the conflict that I no longer even recall what the dispute was about, but I definitely recall the resolution.
recall.translationZh: 这件事发生在多年前，由于那场冲突实在微不足道，我已经完全不记得当初是为了什么而争执，但我对解决结果依然记忆犹新。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

recall.sentenceEn: To overcome this kind of internal obstacle, recall your other positive traits and personality characteristics.
recall.translationZh: 要克服这类内在障碍，请回想一下你其他的积极特质和人格特征。

recall.sentenceEn: The Turing test was conceived, you may recall , as a way of enabling humans to determine whether a machine could respond in such a way that one couldn't tell whether it was a human or a robot.
recall.translationZh: 你可能还记得，图灵测试的构思初衷是让人们能够判断：一台机器的反应是否已经达到了让人无法分辨其究竟是人类还是机器人的程度。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

recall.sentenceEn: The memory bias was unrelated to the measures of how well they'd understood or recalled the text, suggesting these factors didn't play a role in memory of initial belief or awareness of belief change.
recall.translationZh: 记忆偏差与他们对文本的理解或回忆程度无关，这表明这些因素在初始信念记忆或信念变化意识中并未发挥作用。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

recall.sentenceEn: Finally, the researchers asked them to recall what their belief had been at the start of the study.
recall.translationZh: 最后，研究人员让他们回忆在研究开始时自己的信念是什么。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

recall.sentenceEn: What does the speaker definitely recall about the dispute mentioned as an example?
recall.translationZh: 关于作为例子提到的那场争论，说话者肯定记得的是什么？

reduction.sentenceEn: According to our research at the University of California, Davis, if the practice of Meatless Monday were to be adopted by all Americans, we'd see a reduction of only 0.5 percent.
reduction.translationZh: 根据我们在加州大学戴维斯分校的研究，如果所有美国人都采用“无肉星期一”的做法，我们只会看到0.5%的减少。

reduction.sentenceEn: Those who began exercising in middle age also saw reductions in their incidence of chronic diseases, such as heart disease and cancer, which were similar to the steady exercisers.
reduction.translationZh: 那些从中老年时期开始锻炼的人，其心脏病和癌症等慢性病的发病率也有所下降，下降程度与长期坚持锻炼的人群相似。
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

reduction.sentenceEn: Many of the studies did show a reduction in the concentration of volatile organic compounds over time, which is likely why people have seized on them to praise the air purifying virtues of plants.
reduction.translationZh: 许多研究确实表明，随着时间的推移，挥发性有机化合物的浓度有所降低，这可能就是为什么人们会抓住这一点来赞扬植物的空气净化功效。
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reduction.sentenceEn: The huge reductions in the numbers of flying insects can only mean a reduction in spiders' food supply.
reduction.translationZh: 飞行昆虫数量的大幅减少，必然意味着蜘蛛食物来源的减少。
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reduction.sentenceEn: The largest coal use reductions at colleges were in Michigan, Missouri, Tennessee and Indiana.
reduction.translationZh: 各大学煤炭使用量减少最多的州为密歇根州、密苏里州、田纳西州和印第安纳州。
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

reduction.sentenceEn: Recent research has shown that even if Americans quit eating meat altogether, the resulting reduction of greenhouse gases in the U.S. would be slight.
reduction.translationZh: 近期研究表明，即使美国人完全停止食用肉类，美国温室气体排放的减少幅度也会非常有限。

resist.sentenceEn: But mindfulness can help us resist the attention economy and relish the things that make life special, like being together with those we love.
resist.translationZh: 但正念能帮助我们抵御注意力经济的诱惑，去细细品味那些让生命充满意义的美好时光，比如与所爱之人共处的时刻。
resist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

resist.sentenceEn: It means practicing being fully present in another person's presence and listening to them with complete attention without judgment, while resisting the urge to make the interaction about you.
resist.translationZh: 这意味着练习全身心地投入到与他人的相处中，全神贯注地倾听对方而无需评判，同时克制住将互动中心转向自己的冲动。
resist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

resist.sentenceEn: Think about the last time you vowed to resist a temptation.
resist.translationZh: 回想一下你上次发誓要抵制某种诱惑的时刻。

resist.sentenceEn: W: But walking away from millions of dollars at the height of your career, most people wouldn't be able to resist the lure of such a high salary.
resist.translationZh: 但是在职业生涯的巅峰时期放弃数百万美元的收入，大多数人都无法抗拒如此高薪的诱惑。
resist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

resist.sentenceEn: When you spend time learning a new task rather than resisting it, your productivity goes up.
resist.translationZh: 当你花时间学习新任务而非抗拒它时，你的工作效率就会提高。
resist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

resist.sentenceEn: They render users incapable of resisting temptation.
resist.translationZh: 它们让用户变得无法抵御诱惑。

reverse.sentenceEn: In fact, that progress began to reverse during the pandemic(大流行病).
reverse.translationZh: 事实上，这种进步在大流行病期间开始逆转。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

reverse.sentenceEn: Of course, overhauling teaching approaches can't fix all the frustrations teachers have, such as low pay, but early results from Mesa show team teaching may be helping to reverse low morale.
reverse.translationZh: 当然，改革教学方法无法解决教师面临的所有困扰，例如薪资偏低的问题，但梅萨学区的初步结果显示，团队教学或许有助于扭转士气低落的状况。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

reverse.sentenceEn: It looks like loneliness can be reversed .
reverse.translationZh: 但好消息是，孤独感似乎是可以逆转的。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

reverse.sentenceEn: Well, the researchers cited a marketing campaign designed to reverse the sales decline of carrots.
reverse.translationZh: 研究人员引用了一项旨在扭转胡萝卜销量下滑的营销活动。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

reverse.sentenceEn: If we doubt our ability to reverse ecological deterioration, we are throwing away the chance to take action.
reverse.translationZh: 如果我们怀疑自己扭转生态恶化的能力，就是在放弃采取行动的机会。

reverse.sentenceEn: The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse .
reverse.translationZh: 职场薪酬公平的进程开始出现逆转。

roommate.sentenceEn: You miss your roommates from university, don't you?
roommate.translationZh: 你是想念大学时的室友了，对吗？
roommate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

roommate.sentenceEn: When I got my first place I remember thinking I couldn't wait to live by myself and get away from my juvenile roommates and all their annoying habits.
roommate.translationZh: 我记得我第一次有自己的住处时，一心盼着能独自生活，远离那些幼稚的室友和他们所有烦人的习惯。
roommate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

roommate.sentenceEn: M: Look, you lived at home with us, and then you had three roommates , and this is your first time living alone.
roommate.translationZh: M：你看，你之前一直和家人住在一起，后来又有三个室友，这是你第一次一个人生活。
roommate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

roommate.sentenceEn: Russell Fazio, an Ohio State psychology professor who has studied interracial roommates there and at Indiana University, discovered an intriguing academic effect.
roommate.translationZh: 罗素·法齐奥是俄亥俄州立大学的心理学教授，他在该校和印第安纳大学都对跨种族室友进行过研究，发现了一个有趣的学术效应。
roommate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

retrieve.sentenceEn: But as we age, many of us have difficulty retrieving memories.

retrieve.sentenceEn: Researchers Tarek Amer, Jordana Wynn and Lynn Hasher looked at several behavioral and brain imaging studies, which show that older adults have difficulty suppressing information that is no longer relevant and that when searching for a specific memory, they often retrieve other, irrelevant memories along with it.

retrieve.sentenceEn: M: Well, depending on the ensuing operative scenario, if I need to wipe the system directories clean in order to reconfigure default protocols, then my first intervention should be to intricately retrieve all inventories that I can.

retrieve.sentenceEn: The experimenters demonstrated how to open the box to retrieve the treat, but they also included the irrelevant step of tapping on the box with a stick.

recognise.sentenceEn: We may recognise that we feel and act differently in these roles and relationships than we do at work.
