reasoning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

reasoning.sentenceEn: Left-brained people are supposedly logical and excel at language and math while right-brained people are more imaginative, emotionally intelligent and skilled with spatial reasoning .
reasoning.translationZh: 据说左脑型的人逻辑性强，擅长语言和数学，而右脑型的人则更富有想象力，情商更高，并且在空间推理方面更有天赋。
reasoning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

reasoning.sentenceEn: Presumably it's an appeal to rationality of some sort that forms the basis of more complex reasoning .
reasoning.translationZh: 想必这是对某种理性的诉求，而这种理性构成了更复杂推理的基础。
reasoning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

reasoning.sentenceEn: Schellenberg had long been skeptical of the science supporting claims that music education enhances children's abstract reasoning , math, or language skills.
reasoning.translationZh: 舍伦贝格长期以来一直对那些声称音乐教育能提高儿童抽象推理能力、数学能力或语言能力的科学依据持怀疑态度。

reasoning.sentenceEn: By acquiring reasoning skills in the first few years of college, students can lay a foundation for lifelong learning.
reasoning.translationZh: 学生在大学前几年通过获取推理技能，可以为终身学习奠定基础。

reasoning.sentenceEn: It fails to correct mistakes through serious reasoning .
reasoning.translationZh: 它无法通过严谨推理来纠正错误。

request.sentenceEn: Then I was presented with another image and another grid — also with a request to identify road signs.
request.translationZh: 接着，我又看到了另一张图片和网格，同样要求我识别出其中的路标。
request.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

request.sentenceEn: Not surprisingly, only eight people responded positively to the wedding invitations and money requests .
request.translationZh: 不出所料，只有八个人对婚礼邀请和费用要求给予了积极回应。
request.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

request.sentenceEn: In 1997 Congress requested the National Institute of Child Health and Human Development and the Department of Education to convene a National Reading Panel to end the "reading wars" and synthesize the evidence.
request.translationZh: 1997年，美国国会要求美国国家儿童健康与人类发展研究所和教育部组建国家阅读专门小组，以终结这场“阅读之争”并综合相关证据。
request.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

request.sentenceEn: It's for this reason that managers should never discriminate when it comes to requests from employees for flexible work arrangements.
request.translationZh: 正是出于这个原因，管理者在处理员工提出的弹性工作安排请求时，绝不应区别对待。
request.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

request.sentenceEn: A product request was sent to eight different glass makers.
request.translationZh: 公司向八家不同的玻璃制造商发出了产品需求。
request.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

request.sentenceEn: Workers at the Root Glass Company got the request and began flipping through the encyclopedia at the local library, landing on cocoa seed.
request.translationZh: 鲁特玻璃公司的员工收到了这个需求，便开始在当地图书馆翻阅百科全书，最终找到了可可豆的条目。
request.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

resilience.sentenceEn: Beyond ensuring that library construction projects consider environmental impact, libraries can take a lead in supporting local foods and craftsmen, like the Peabody Institute Library's partnering with local businesses to pioneer a farmers' market in their courtyard, or the Richmond Public Library's seed lending library which "nurtures locally-adapted plant varieties, and fosters community resilience (韧性), self-reliance and a culture of sharing."
resilience.translationZh: 除了确保图书馆建设项目考虑环境影响外，图书馆还可以带头支持本地食品和手工艺人，例如皮博迪研究所图书馆与当地企业合作，在其庭院开创农贸市场，或者里士满公共图书馆的种子借阅图书馆，该图书馆“培育适应当地的植物品种，培养社区韧性、自力更生和分享文化。”

resilience.sentenceEn: Practicing self-compassion increases your resilience (韧性), emotional intelligence, compassion toward others, and can boost your performance as well as help you develop a growth mindset.
resilience.translationZh: 练习自我同情能增强你的韧性、情商以及对他人的同理心，同时还能提升你的表现，并帮助你培养成长型思维。

resilience.sentenceEn: If you're trying to build resilience at work, you need adequate internal and external recovery periods.
resilience.translationZh: 如果你想在工作中培养复原力，就需要充足的内部恢复期和外部恢复期。

resilience.sentenceEn: Overwork and exhaustion are the opposite of resilience and the bad habits we acquire when we're young only magnify when we hit the workforce.
resilience.translationZh: 过度工作和疲惫与恢复力背道而驰，而我们年轻时养成的坏习惯，在进入职场后只会愈演愈烈。

resilience.sentenceEn: People's distorted view about resilience may have developed from their upbringing.
resilience.translationZh: 人们对复原力的错误认知可能源于其成长过程。

resilience.sentenceEn: Resilience Is About How You Recharge, Not How You Endure
resilience.translationZh: 韧性的关键在于如何恢复精力，而非如何忍受

roof.sentenceEn: These beams, known as la forêt (the forest) because of their density, formed the cross-shaped roof that ran the length of the central part of the cathedral.
roof.translationZh: 这些木梁因密度极高而被称为"la forêt"（森林），它们构成了十字形的屋顶，横跨整个教堂中央区域。

roof.sentenceEn: Most of the wooden roof beams have been burned, and parts of the concrete holding up the roof have collapsed.
roof.translationZh: 大部分木质屋顶横梁已被烧毁，支撑屋顶的部分混凝土结构也已坍塌。

roof.sentenceEn: Behind a heap of blackened oak beams that lay piled up where they had fallen, daylight from vast holes in the cathedral roof lit a golden cross over a statue by Nicolas Coustou, which appeared to have escaped damage.
roof.translationZh: 在一堆坍塌后堆积在一起的焦黑橡木梁后面，教堂屋顶巨大破洞中透进的日光，照亮了尼古拉·库斯托一尊雕像上方的金色十字架——这尊雕像似乎未受损伤。

roof.sentenceEn: The second alert was sounded at 6:43 pm, and the blaze was discovered on the roof .
roof.translationZh: 第二次警报于当晚6点43分响起，随后在屋顶发现了火情。

roof.sentenceEn: The roof of Notre Dame Cathedral was built with large numbers of densely laid-out wood beams.
roof.translationZh: 巴黎圣母院的屋顶由大量密集铺设的木梁建成。

roof.sentenceEn: The roof of their cottage collapsed in the flood.
roof.translationZh: 他们小屋的屋顶在洪水中坍塌了。

roughly.sentenceEn: A 10% growth rate over a prolonged period means that income levels double roughly every seven years.
roughly.translationZh: 长期保持10%的增长率意味着收入水平大约每七年翻一番。
roughly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

roughly.sentenceEn: Roughly speaking, about 40% of a person's personality is determined by their genes, the other 60% by their environment.
roughly.translationZh: 大致而言，一个人的性格约40%由基因决定，其余60%则受环境影响。
roughly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

roughly.sentenceEn: One clear piece of evidence is the widening gap between productivity growth and wage growth since roughly 1970.
roughly.translationZh: 一个明显的证据是，自大约1970年以来，生产率增长与工资增长之间的差距不断扩大。
roughly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

roughly.sentenceEn: Child mortality was roughly half what it was as recently as 1990.
roughly.translationZh: 儿童死亡率较近在1990年的水平已大致下降一半。
roughly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

roughly.sentenceEn: On the islands, there's even a colloquial(口头的) expression for the idea of making medical care your lowest priority: It's known as "rog pushai rakha" in Bengali, which roughly translates to "stockpiling their diseases"—waiting to seek medical attention until a condition becomes extremely serious.
roughly.translationZh: 在这些岛屿上，甚至有一个口头短语来形容这种将医疗保健置于最末位的观念：孟加拉语中称为"rog pushai rakha"，大致可译为"囤积疾病"——即等到病情变得极其严重时才寻求医疗救助。

roughly.sentenceEn: Parts of Africa are getting warmer much faster than the average, with southern Africa witnessing roughly twice the global warming rate over the last half century.
roughly.translationZh: 非洲部分地区正以远超平均水平的速度变暖，其中南部非洲在过去半个世纪的升温速率约为全球平均水平的两倍。

random.sentenceEn: The husbands then go to the pharmacy, try to describe the issue and return home with some random medicines.
random.translationZh: 然后丈夫们会去药房，试着描述病情，最后买回一些随意的药物。

random.sentenceEn: The thought of a computer generating a "random" piece of music that hasn't been painstakingly created by an artist is almost seen as sacrilegious(亵渎神圣的).
random.translationZh: 想到计算机生成一段并非由艺术家精心创作的"随机"音乐，几乎会被视为亵渎神圣。
random.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

random.sentenceEn: In such studies, researchers would need to follow groups of children with and without music lessons over a long period of time—even if the assignments are not completely random .
random.translationZh: 在这类研究中，研究人员需要对接受和未接受音乐课程的儿童群体进行长期跟踪——即使分组并非完全随机。

random.sentenceEn: Consulting a random doctor patients will never meet, they say, further fragments the health-care system, and even minor issues such as upper respiratory(上呼吸道的) infections can't be thoroughly evaluated by a doctor who can't listen to your heart or feel your swollen glands.
random.translationZh: 他们表示，咨询一位患者素未谋面的随机医生会进一步分割医疗系统，而且像上呼吸道感染这样的小病，医生如果无法听诊心脏或触摸肿大的腺体，也无法进行彻底评估。

random.sentenceEn: It is often random events or preferences that determine the fate of a piece of art.
random.translationZh: 一件艺术品的命运往往由随机事件或偏好决定。

random.sentenceEn: It cannot be produced at random .
random.translationZh: 音乐不能随意创作出来。

raw.sentenceEn: Modelled on the movements of a MasterChef contest winner, Tim Anderson, its robotic arms are fixed over a stove and programmed to prepare dishes from raw ingredients.
raw.translationZh: 其机械臂模仿了《顶级厨师》冠军蒂姆·安德森的动作，固定在炉灶上方，并可通过编程从原始食材开始烹饪菜肴。

raw.sentenceEn: It could be that our raw intelligence gave us an unprecedented ability to think outside the box, innovating solutions to thorny problems as people migrated across the globe.
raw.translationZh: 这可能是因为我们原始的智力赋予了我们前所未有的跳出思维定势的能力，在人类向全球迁移的过程中不断创新，解决棘手难题。
raw.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

raw.sentenceEn: Across the region it has doubled its use of local raw material to about 80% over five years, says John O'Keeffe, who runs its Africa business.
raw.translationZh: 负责非洲业务的约翰·奥基夫表示，五年来该公司在整个地区对本地原材料的使用率翻了一番，达到约80%。

raw.sentenceEn: This is partly driven by the rising price of raw materials and metals.
raw.translationZh: 这部分是由原材料和金属价格上涨推动的。

raw.sentenceEn: What does the author say about the use of raw sewage for farming?
raw.translationZh: 作者对使用未经处理的下水道污水进行农业种植有何看法？

raw.sentenceEn: They are equipped with raw strength for solving the most challenging problems.
raw.translationZh: 它们具备解决最具挑战性问题的原始力量。

realistic.sentenceEn: The final consideration is a financial one, potential B&B hosts must be realistic about opportunities for income.
realistic.translationZh: 最后一个要考虑的是财务问题，潜在的民宿经营者必须对收入前景抱有务实的态度。
realistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

realistic.sentenceEn: And while these programmes are regularly among the most-watched shows, news broadcasts—which paint a more realistic view of the economic hardship faced by millions of Americans—get a much smaller proportion of the viewership.
realistic.translationZh: 尽管这些节目常常位居收视率最高的节目之列，但新闻广播——它们更真实地展现了数百万美国人面临的经济困境——的观众比例却要小得多。
realistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

realistic.sentenceEn: But repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic , which can lead to severe negative emotional consequences when it doesn't reoccur.
realistic.translationZh: 但重复那种成就往往不切实际，当无法再次实现时，可能会导致严重的负面情绪后果。
realistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

realistic.sentenceEn: We mistakenly think of "good" drawings as those which work as recreations of the real world, as realistic illusions.
realistic.translationZh: 我们错误地认为，"好"的绘画作品就是那些能够再现现实世界、营造逼真幻象的作品。
realistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

realistic.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say potential B&B hosts must be realistic about?
realistic.translationZh: 发言人认为潜在的民宿房东必须对什么抱有现实的态度？

realistic.sentenceEn: Drawing should be redefined as a realistic illusion.
realistic.translationZh: 绘画应该被重新定义为一种逼真的幻觉。

recycle.sentenceEn: About 1 million plastic bottles are sold each minute around the globe and, with just 14% recycled , many end up in the oceans where they have polluted even the remotest parts, harming marine life and potentially people who eat sea food.
recycle.translationZh: 全球每分钟约售出100万个塑料瓶，而仅14%得到回收利用，许多塑料瓶最终进入海洋，污染了即使是最偏远的海域，对海洋生物以及可能食用海鲜的人类造成危害。
recycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

recycle.sentenceEn: "What we are hoping to do is use this enzyme to turn this plastic back into its original components, so we can literally recycle it back to plastic," said McGeehan.
recycle.translationZh: 麦吉汉表示：“我们希望利用这种酶将塑料分解为其原始成分，这样我们就可以真正将其回炼成塑料。”
recycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

recycle.sentenceEn: "It is so easy for manufacturers to generate more of that stuff, rather than even try to recycle , but I believe there is a public interest here: perception is changing so much that companies are starting to look at how they can properly recycle these bottles."
recycle.translationZh: 制造商们很容易就能生产出更多这样的东西，而不是尝试回收利用，但我相信这里存在着公共利益：公众观念正在发生巨大变化，以至于企业开始研究如何才能恰当地回收这些瓶子。
recycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

recycle.sentenceEn: Currently those bottles that are recycled can only be turned into opaque fibres for clothing or carpets, while the new enzyme indicates a way to recycle old clear plastic bottles back into new clear plastic bottles.
recycle.translationZh: 目前，那些被回收的瓶子只能被制成用于服装或地毯的不透明纤维，而这种新酶则为将旧的透明塑料瓶回收再制成新的透明塑料瓶指明了方向。
recycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

recycle.sentenceEn: Recycling used products can help manufacturers reduce production costs.
recycle.translationZh: 回收利用旧产品可以帮助制造商降低生产成本。

recycle.sentenceEn: Recycle used space vehicles before they turn into debris.
recycle.translationZh: 在废旧航天器变成太空碎片之前对其进行回收利用。

reproduce.sentenceEn: The caveman who always assumed there was a lion behind the next rock would usually be wrong, but he'd be much more likely to survive and reproduce than one who always assumed the opposite.
reproduce.translationZh: 总是认为下一块岩石后面藏着狮子的穴居人通常是错的，但比起那些总是做相反假设的穴居人，他更有可能生存下来并繁衍后代。
reproduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

reproduce.sentenceEn: Later, IKEA successfully reproduced this formula in many other countries.
reproduce.translationZh: 后来，宜家成功地将这一模式复制到了许多其他国家。
reproduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

reproduce.sentenceEn: Should the public be allowed to use or reproduce images of famous people, given how iconic they are?
reproduce.translationZh: 考虑到名人形象的标志性意义，公众是否应该被允许使用或复制他们的肖像？

reproduce.sentenceEn: And, ironic as it sounds, since humans have wiped out many animal predators, some see hunting as a natural way to reduce the herds of prey animals that now reproduce beyond the environment's carrying capacity.
reproduce.translationZh: 然而，听起来颇具讽刺意味的是，由于人类已经消灭了许多肉食动物，一些人将狩猎视为一种自然的方式，以减少如今繁殖数量已超出环境承载能力的猎物群。
reproduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

reproduce.sentenceEn: Farrant is trying to isolate genes in resurrection plants and reproduce them in crops.
reproduce.translationZh: 法兰特正试图分离复苏植物中的基因，并将其在农作物中重现。

reproduce.sentenceEn: It is a bacterium that reproduces at a high rate.
reproduce.translationZh: 这是一种繁殖速度很快的细菌。

restore.sentenceEn: Scientists say that sequencing every species will revolutionise the understanding of biology and evolution, bolster efforts to conserve as well as protect and restore biodiversity.
restore.translationZh: 科学家表示，对每个物种进行测序将彻底改变我们对生物学和进化的理解，并加强保护、维护和恢复生物多样性的努力。
restore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

restore.sentenceEn: "We have been in this cycle of environmental generational amnesia for a long time, where the baseline keeps shifting and we don't even realize what we're losing until it's gone. If we can get people to understand how much meaning and value can come from having more experiences with more wild forms of nature, then maybe we can stop this cycle and move toward conserving and restoring what we have left."
restore.translationZh: 我们长期处于这种环境代际遗忘的循环中，环境基准不断变化，直到失去后我们才意识到自己究竟失去了什么。如果我们能让人们理解，更多地体验更原始的自然形态能带来多少意义和价值，那么或许我们就能打破这个循环，转而保护和恢复我们所剩的自然环境。

restore.sentenceEn: Economic theory says that unlike income or sales taxes, carbon taxes can actually increase economic efficiency; because companies that pump carbon dioxide into the sky don't pay the costs of the climate change they cause, carbon taxes would restore the proper incentives to the market.
restore.translationZh: 经济学理论认为，与所得税或销售税不同，碳税实际上可以提高经济效率；因为向大气排放二氧化碳的企业并未承担其造成的气候变化成本，而碳税将为市场恢复恰当的激励机制。
restore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

restore.sentenceEn: No matter what we do to restore habitat or support population growth, we may never be able to restore that culture.
restore.translationZh: 无论我们如何努力恢复栖息地或促进种群增长，都可能永远无法复原那种文化。
restore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

restore.sentenceEn: For other companies interested in reducing waste, helping the environment, and providing the sustainable lifestyles that consumers seek, here are some first steps for building a relationship with customers that focuses on recycling and restoring value to products.
restore.translationZh: 对于其他有兴趣减少浪费、保护环境并提供消费者所追求的可持续生活方式的公司，以下是一些与客户建立注重产品回收和价值恢复关系的初步步骤。

restore.sentenceEn: Restore social order for a harmonious nation.
restore.translationZh: 恢复社会秩序，构建和谐国家。

retire.sentenceEn: Having just retired from teaching at a public university, I'm now returning to my hometown of Flagstaff, Arizona, to establish a tiny college—Flagstaff College.
retire.translationZh: 刚从一所公立大学退休，我现在回到了亚利桑那州弗拉格斯塔夫的家乡，准备创办一所小型学院——弗拉格斯塔夫学院。

retire.sentenceEn: I'm not asking you to retire just to slow down a bit.
retire.translationZh: 我不是让你退休，只是稍微放慢一点节奏。
retire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第2句

retire.sentenceEn: Why did you retire so early?
retire.translationZh: 你为什么这么早就退役了？
retire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

retire.sentenceEn: This isn't really good for anyone, and it's certainly no good for graduates, who are forced to endure a lifestyle where they can never save up, never buy a house, never hope to retire .
retire.translationZh: 这对任何人都没有好处，对于毕业生来说尤其糟糕，他们被迫忍受一种永远无法储蓄、无法买房、甚至无法奢望退休的生活。
retire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

retire.sentenceEn: "I don't expect to run a step with Mike, but I will be excited to see how he does," said the 34-year-old Hall, who began weight-lifting after retiring .
retire.translationZh: 34岁的霍尔在退役后开始了举重训练，他说：“我不指望能跟上迈克的步伐，但看到他的表现我会很兴奋。”

retire.sentenceEn: Most of them never hope to buy a house or to retire .
retire.translationZh: 他们中的大多数人从未奢望过买房或退休。

roll.sentenceEn: A lot of headlines about moons are just ridiculous (you do not need to be particularly excited about a blue moon, it just looks like a regular full moon), but you should definitely roll out of bed to look at a blood moon if one is going to be visible in your region, even though they're just lunar eclipses and not evidence of bloody battles between the sky gods.
roll.translationZh: 许多关于月亮的新闻标题都很荒谬（你不必对蓝月亮特别兴奋，它看起来就像普通的满月），但如果你的地区能看到血月，你绝对应该起床去看看，尽管它们只是月食，并非天空诸神之间血腥战斗的证据。

roll.sentenceEn: They're the ones partying until 2 a.m. the night before the final, so that when the grade C rolls in, there's a ready excuse.
roll.translationZh: 他们会在期末考试前夜聚会到凌晨两点，这样当拿到C等成绩时，就有了现成的借口。

roll.sentenceEn: Rock and roll had always been an important part of my life.
roll.translationZh: 摇滚乐一直是我生命中重要的一部分。
roll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

roll.sentenceEn: I remember my friends and I used to drive around until the late hours of the nights listening to the music of Rock and Roll legends.
roll.translationZh: 我记得我和朋友们常常开车四处游荡，直到深夜，听着摇滚传奇的音乐。
roll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

roll.sentenceEn: The practice of destroying unsold stock, and even rolls of unused fabric, is commonplace for luxury labels.
roll.translationZh: 对于奢侈品牌而言，销毁未售出的库存，甚至整卷未使用的面料，是一种常见做法。

roll.sentenceEn: These fragments got their smooth round shape by rolling along the stream bottom.
roll.translationZh: 这些碎骨是在溪底滚动时形成了光滑圆润的形状。
roll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

romance.sentenceEn: The Sun Is Also a Star is a truly lovely story of love, romance , fate, and destiny.
romance.translationZh: 《太阳也是一颗星》讲述了一个关于爱情、浪漫、机缘与命运的温馨故事。
romance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

romance.sentenceEn: I used to find romance stories to always be cheap or laughable.
romance.translationZh: 我过去总觉得爱情故事要么廉价要么可笑。
romance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

romance.sentenceEn: In the 1970s, the term "environment" gained currency, becoming widely adopted in the English and Romance languages, and as "Umwelt" ("surrounding world") in German.
romance.translationZh: 20世纪70年代，“environment”一词开始流行，在英语和罗曼语族语言中被广泛采用，在德语中则称为“Umwelt”（意为“周围世界”）。

romance.sentenceEn: For the majority of us, the moment we begin to date seriously, there's a competition between romance and friendship.
romance.translationZh: 对于我们大多数人而言，当我们开始认真约会的那一刻起，爱情与友情之间就出现了一种竞争关系。
romance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第8句

romance.sentenceEn: Danielle Steel, the 71-year-old romance novelist is notoriously productive, having published 179 books at a rate of up to seven a year.
romance.translationZh: 71岁的浪漫小说家丹妮尔·斯蒂尔以高产著称，她已出版179部作品，创作速度高达每年7部。
romance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

romance.translationZh: 他们将爱情置于友情之上。

recreate.sentenceEn: Trying to recreate their designs would have been futile.
recreate.translationZh: 试图重现他们的设计是徒劳的。
recreate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

recreate.sentenceEn: More and more city planners are paying increasing attention to encouraging physical activity by making it easier and safer for people to recreate , walk, bike and take public transportation.
recreate.translationZh: 越来越多的城市规划者正日益重视鼓励体育活动，他们通过改善环境，让人们更轻松、更安全地进行娱乐活动、步行、骑自行车和乘坐公共交通。
recreate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

recreate.sentenceEn: Before his death, he filed a deed protecting the use of his image until 2039, preventing others from recreating him using CGI to appear in a film, TV show or as a hologram(全息影像).
recreate.translationZh: 去世前，他提交了一份契约，保护自己的形象使用权至2039年，禁止他人利用CGI技术将其重现在电影、电视节目中或制作成全息影像。

recreate.sentenceEn: A hidden hazard of digitally recreating a deceased(已故的) celebrity is the risk of damaging their legacy.
recreate.translationZh: 以数字方式重现已故名人的一个潜在隐患是可能会损害他们的遗产。

recreate.sentenceEn: As it becomes easier to digitally recreate celebrities and to entirely manufacture on-screen identities, could this kind of technology put actors out of jobs?
recreate.translationZh: 随着对名人进行数字重建以及完全打造银幕身份变得越来越容易，这类技术会让演员失业吗？

recreate.sentenceEn: There is an ongoing debate among the public as to whether the images of deceased celebrities should be recreated .
recreate.translationZh: 公众正在就是否应该重现已故名人的形象展开讨论。

repeatedly.sentenceEn: The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning.
repeatedly.translationZh: 能够在无限制、无风险的模型中探索、实验并反复应用新知识，这使模拟成为最高效的学习方式之一。
repeatedly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

repeatedly.sentenceEn: You must take into account whether all members of the family truly enjoy visitors, want to repeatedly discuss local sites and activities, and have the time and energy to handle the additional cooking, cleaning, laundry and the bookkeeping involved.
repeatedly.translationZh: 你必须考虑到家里的所有成员是否真的喜欢有客人来访，是否愿意反复讨论当地的景点和活动，以及是否有时间和精力去应付额外增加的烹饪、清洁、洗涤和相关的账目开支。
repeatedly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

repeatedly.sentenceEn: We humans love to believe we are special, but science and technology have repeatedly proved this conviction wrong.
repeatedly.translationZh: 我们人类总喜欢相信自己是特别的，但科学与技术已一再证明这种信念是错误的。
repeatedly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

repeatedly.sentenceEn: People who repeatedly give unwanted advice can be well-meaning and genuinely want to help.
repeatedly.translationZh: 那些频繁提供不请自来的建议的人，可能出于好意，并真心想要提供帮助。
repeatedly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

repeatedly.sentenceEn: The participants in a recent study repeatedly underestimated the positive effect on those who received thank-you notes.
repeatedly.translationZh: 最近一项研究的参与者一再低估了感谢信对收件人的积极影响。

repeatedly.sentenceEn: They were repeatedly rejected by shops.

resistance.sentenceEn: But the reason women are so dramatically underrepresented in U.S. government is not because they face resistance from voters or struggle to raise money.
resistance.translationZh: 但女性在美国政府中代表性严重不足的原因，并非她们面临选民的抵制或筹款困难。
resistance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

resistance.sentenceEn: But "the resistance was enormous," he recalls.
resistance.translationZh: 但他回忆道：“当时的阻力非常大。”

resistance.sentenceEn: Antibiotic resistance is a serious threat to health and the problem is growing.
resistance.translationZh: 抗生素耐药性对健康构成严重威胁，且这一问题日益加剧。
resistance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

resistance.translationZh: 答案就是抗生素耐药性。
resistance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

resistance.sentenceEn: Despite consumer resistance , researchers are pushing ahead with genetic modification of crops.
resistance.translationZh: 尽管消费者存在抵触情绪，研究人员仍在推进农作物的基因改造工作。
对抗细菌对抗生素的耐药性

rival.sentenceEn: Invariably, over the next 10 years, jobs will go in conventional bricks-built restaurants, not least because automation will boost their rapidly growing rival : delivery.
rival.translationZh: 在未来的十年里，传统实体餐厅的岗位必将逐步缩减，这在很大程度上是因为自动化将助力其飞速成长的竞争对手：外卖行业。

rival.sentenceEn: These days, LinkedIn alerts us when our rival gets a new job, and Instagram can let us know how well "liked" our lives are compared with a friend's.
rival.translationZh: 如今，当我们的竞争对手找到新工作时，领英(LinkedIn)会提醒我们；而Instagram则能让我们知道，与朋友相比，我们的生活获得了多少“点赞”。

rival.sentenceEn: And while the cult of tax cuts has attracted many critics, it lacks for obvious rivals .
rival.translationZh: 尽管这种对减税的狂热崇拜招致了诸多批评，但它却缺乏明显的竞争对手。
rival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

rival.sentenceEn: So far, the main thing many large retailers have done in response to all this is to open online stores, so people will come to them directly rather than to Amazon and its smaller online rivals .
rival.translationZh: 迄今为止，面对这一切，许多大型零售商的主要应对措施是开设网店，以便让消费者直接访问他们，而非转向亚马逊及其规模较小的在线竞争对手。

rival.sentenceEn: America lacked the incentive to care for the majority of its citizens as it found no rival for its economic model.
rival.translationZh: 由于美国的经济模式找不到竞争对手，它便失去了为大多数公民谋福祉的动力。

rival.sentenceEn: They became rivals of their Parisian counterparts.
rival.translationZh: 她们成为了与巴黎同行相抗衡的对手。

robotic.sentenceEn: Modelled on the movements of a MasterChef contest winner, Tim Anderson, its robotic arms are fixed over a stove and programmed to prepare dishes from raw ingredients.
robotic.translationZh: 其机械臂模仿了《顶级厨师》冠军蒂姆·安德森的动作，固定在炉灶上方，并可通过编程从原始食材开始烹饪菜肴。

robotic.sentenceEn: It may only be five years before the use of automation technology leads to a fully robotic mine.
robotic.translationZh: 或许只需五年时间，自动化技术的应用就能催生完全机器人化的矿山。
robotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

robotic.sentenceEn: And this may well prove to be the most significant impact of robotic technology in many places around the world.
robotic.translationZh: 而这很可能成为机器人技术在全球许多地区产生的最显著影响。
robotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

robotic.sentenceEn: A robot's appearance affects its ability to successfully interact with humans, which is why the RIKEN-TRI Collaboration Center for Human-Interactive Robot Research decided to develop a robotic nurse that looks like a huge teddy bear.
robotic.translationZh: 机器人的外观会影响其与人成功互动的能力，这也是理化研究所-国际电气通信基础技术研究所（RIKEN-TRI）人类交互机器人研究合作中心决定研发一款外形酷似巨大泰迪熊的护理机器人的原因。
robotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

robotic.sentenceEn: Why are farmers pressing for robotic farming?
robotic.translationZh: 为什么农民迫切要求发展机器人农业？
机器人农业已成为发展趋势。

rainbow.sentenceEn: The outer edge of the rainbow arc is red, while the inner edge is violet.
rainbow.translationZh: 彩虹弧的外边缘是红色的，而内边缘是紫色的。
rainbow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

rainbow.sentenceEn: Rainbows present a spectrum made up of seven colors in a specific order.
rainbow.translationZh: 彩虹呈现出由七种颜色按特定顺序组成的光谱。
rainbow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

rainbow.sentenceEn: An observer may perceive a rainbow to be located either near or far away, but this phenomenon is not actually located at any specific spot.
rainbow.translationZh: 观察者可能会觉得彩虹近在咫尺或远在天边，但这种现象实际上并不存在于任何特定位置。
rainbow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

rainbow.sentenceEn: In fact, school children in many English-speaking countries are taught to remember the name "Roy G. Biv" as an aid for remembering the colors of a rainbow and their order.
rainbow.translationZh: 事实上，许多英语国家的学童被教导记住"Roy G. Biv"这个名字，以帮助他们记忆彩虹的颜色及其顺序。
rainbow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

rainbow.sentenceEn: Instead, the appearance of a rainbow depends entirely upon the position of the observer in relation to the direction of light.
rainbow.translationZh: 相反，彩虹的出现完全取决于观察者相对于光线方向的位置。
rainbow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

rainbow.sentenceEn: A rainbow is formed because white light enters the water droplet, where it bends in several different directions.
rainbow.translationZh: 彩虹的形成是因为白光进入水滴后会向不同方向折射。
rainbow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

randomly.sentenceEn: Each parent-child pair was randomly assigned to read either two educational electronic books or two printed books with the same content.
randomly.translationZh: 每对家长和孩子被随机分配阅读两本电子教育书籍，或两本内容相同的纸质书。
randomly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

randomly.sentenceEn: The author, composer and psychologist Glenn Schellenberg had conducted an experiment with 144 children randomly assigned to four groups: one learned the keyboard for a year, one took singing lessons, one joined an acting class, and a control group had no extracurricular training.
randomly.translationZh: 该论文作者——作曲家兼心理学家格伦·舍伦贝格(Glenn Schellenberg)——对144名儿童进行了一项实验，这些儿童被随机分为四组：一组学习了一年键盘乐器，一组参加声乐课程，一组加入表演班，而对照组则不接受任何课外培训。

randomly.sentenceEn: That may seem compelling, but Habibi's children were not selected randomly .
randomly.translationZh: 这一发现看似令人信服，但哈比比研究中的儿童并非随机选取。

randomly.sentenceEn: Steinberg and Gardner randomly assigned some participants to play alone or with two same-age peers looking on.
randomly.translationZh: 斯坦伯格和加德纳随机分配部分参与者单独游戏，或在两名同龄同伴的旁观下进行游戏。

randomly.sentenceEn: What did the study find about randomly assigned interracial roommates at Ohio State University?
randomly.translationZh: 关于俄亥俄州立大学随机分配的跨种族室友，这项研究有何发现？

randomly.sentenceEn: He clicked on the cells randomly .
randomly.translationZh: 他随机点击了一些单元格。

readily.sentenceEn: Pet dogs can often readily understand a wide range of their owners' commands and gestures, but are these abilities inborn or are they exclusively learned through training?
readily.translationZh: 宠物狗通常能轻松理解主人的各种指令和手势，但这些能力是天生的，还是完全通过训练习得的呢？
readily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

readily.sentenceEn: When new ideas are in accord with what we already believe, they are more readily accepted.
readily.translationZh: 当新观点与我们已有的信念一致时，就更容易被接受。
readily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

readily.sentenceEn: When they are not, they, and the arguments that lead to them, are more readily rejected.
readily.translationZh: 当新观点与我们已有的信念不一致时，这些新观点及其论证过程就更容易被我们拒绝。
readily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

readily.sentenceEn: Americans mostly consume Coke out of aluminum or plastic today, but the glass bottle remains a symbol of America that's readily recognized around the world.
readily.translationZh: 如今，美国人饮用可口可乐时大多使用铝罐或塑料瓶，但这种玻璃瓶仍然是美国的象征，在世界各地都能轻易被认出。
readily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

readily.sentenceEn: Ease of care was most important: summer dresses and outfits, in particular, were chiefly cotton, readily capable of being washed and pressed at home.
readily.translationZh: 易于打理是最重要的：尤其是夏季连衣裙和套装，主要采用棉质面料，便于在家清洗和熨烫。
readily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

readily.sentenceEn: They could readily recognize their owner simply by looking.
readily.translationZh: 它们仅通过观察就能轻易认出自己的主人。

reasonable.sentenceEn: Setting a boundary in this regard, if you feel you need one, is perfectly reasonable and something that can bring you increased emotional safety.
reasonable.translationZh: 在这方面，如果你觉得有必要，设定一个界限是完全合理的，这能为你带来更多的心理安全感。
reasonable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

reasonable.sentenceEn: It is reasonable to conclude that spending is praiseworthy, supposing it is not beyond your means.
reasonable.translationZh: 如果消费不超出自己的经济能力，那么认为消费值得称赞是合理的。
reasonable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

reasonable.sentenceEn: All of the consequences seem reasonable (or at least possible), but I think there might be an interesting philosophical conclusion that they did not draw.
reasonable.translationZh: 所有这些结果似乎都合情合理（或至少有可能），但我认为其中可能蕴含着一个他们未曾得出的有趣哲学结论。
reasonable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

reasonable.sentenceEn: This system would bring once distant regions within reasonable commute to heavy job centers.
reasonable.translationZh: 这一系统将使曾经遥远的地区纳入就业中心的合理通勤范围之内。

reasonable.sentenceEn: Discussing a disability with the potential employer may help them make reasonable workplace adjustments in their favor.
reasonable.translationZh: 与潜在雇主讨论自身残疾情况，可能会帮助雇主做出有利于求职者的合理工作场所调整。
reasonable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

reasonable.sentenceEn: Concede the advice is perfectly reasonable .
reasonable.translationZh: 承认这些建议是完全合理的。

recreation.sentenceEn: They take over protective functions against soil erosion and landslides(塌方); they make a significant contribution to the water balance as they prevent surface runoff; they filter dirt particles, greenhouse gases and radioactive substances from the air; they produce oxygen; they provide spaces for recreation and they preserve historic and prehistoric remains.
recreation.translationZh: 它们承担着防止水土流失和塌方的保护功能；它们通过防止地表径流对水平衡做出重要贡献；它们过滤空气中的尘埃颗粒、温室气体和放射性物质；它们产生氧气；它们提供休闲空间并保护历史和史前遗迹。

recreation.sentenceEn: We mistakenly think of "good" drawings as those which work as recreations of the real world, as realistic illusions.
recreation.translationZh: 我们错误地认为，"好"的绘画作品就是那些能够再现现实世界、营造逼真幻象的作品。
recreation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

recreation.sentenceEn: "I think this is the beginning of an entire wave," says Travis Cloyd, CEO of Worldwide XR, one of the companies behind the digital recreation of Dean.
recreation.translationZh: Worldwide XR公司首席执行官特拉维斯·克洛伊德表示：“我认为这是一整个浪潮的开端。”该公司是参与迪恩数字重现项目的公司之一。

recreation.sentenceEn: Edwards cites widespread backlash to the digital recreation of Carrie Fisher as a young Princess Leia in Rogue One, a trick later repeated in the recent Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, which was filmed after Fisher's death in 2016.
recreation.translationZh: 爱德华兹提到，在《侠盗一号》中对凯丽·费雪饰演的年轻莱娅公主进行数字重现引发了广泛的反对之声。这一技术后来在近期的《星球大战：天行者崛起》中再次使用，而该片的拍摄是在费雪2016年去世之后进行的。

recreation.sentenceEn: A recreation , however lifelike, will never be indistinguishable from a real actor, says Webber.
recreation.translationZh: 韦伯表示，无论数字重建多么逼真，都永远无法与真实演员完全混淆。

recreation.sentenceEn: They have no access to health care, let alone entertainment or recreation .
recreation.translationZh: 他们无法获得医疗服务，更不用说娱乐或休闲活动了。

relief.sentenceEn: If you run to the office kitchen to get some relief with colleagues after a frustrating meeting, you're likely experiencing meeting recovery syndrome.
relief.translationZh: 如果一场令人沮丧的会议后，你跑到办公室厨房和同事们一起放松一下，那么你很可能正在经历会议恢复综合征。

relief.sentenceEn: This suggests that cyberloafing acts as a sort of relief valve for workers, helping them recover from stressful experiences.
relief.translationZh: 这表明，网络摸鱼对员工而言就像是一种泄压阀，帮助他们从充满压力的经历中恢复过来。
relief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第9句

relief.sentenceEn: Many people indeed find relief from soaring summer temperatures in air-conditioned offices.
relief.translationZh: 的确，许多人在有空调的办公室里能够从夏日的酷暑中得到解脱。
relief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

relief.sentenceEn: To the relief of Instagrammers(Instagram用户) everywhere, it can even make meals more enjoyable.
relief.translationZh: 让各地的Instagram用户松了一口气的是，拍照甚至能让用餐体验更加愉悦。
relief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

relief.sentenceEn: That may be one reason why so many people find relief in swimming when life's seas get rough?
relief.translationZh: 这或许就是为什么当生活的波涛变得汹涌时，如此多的人能在游泳中找到慰藉？
relief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

relief.sentenceEn: Many teenagers resort to drugs or alcohol for mental relief .
relief.translationZh: 许多青少年借助毒品或酒精来获得精神慰藉。

religious.sentenceEn: After all, cultures with traditions of religious hermits(隐士) believe that solitude is important for enlightenment.
religious.translationZh: 毕竟，拥有宗教隐士传统的文化认为，独处对于开悟至关重要。

religious.sentenceEn: If we take the time to reflect we might recognise that as well as our work we can also identify as a friend, a spouse, a son or daughter, a parent, a member of a sports team or religious community.
religious.translationZh: 如果我们花时间反思，可能会意识到，除了工作之外，我们还可以将自己定位为朋友、配偶、子女、父母、运动队成员或宗教团体成员。
religious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

religious.sentenceEn: For some, this meaning is religious , some political and some interpersonal.
religious.translationZh: 对一些人来说，这种意义是宗教层面的，一些是政治层面的，还有一些是人际关系层面的。
religious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

religious.sentenceEn: Others are found in ancient religious disciplines, such as reflecting on benefactions received from another person or actually praying for the health and happiness of a benefactor.
religious.translationZh: 其他方法可见于古老的宗教修行中，例如反思从他人那里获得的善行，或为施恩者的健康和幸福祈祷。

religious.sentenceEn: Yet he was also reflecting the wisdom of religious and philosophical traditions that extend back thousands of years.
religious.translationZh: 然而，他同时也在反映那些可追溯至数千年前的宗教与哲学传统中的智慧。

religious.sentenceEn: They often lead to war between religious groups.
religious.translationZh: 它们常常导致宗教群体之间的战争。

republican.sentenceEn: This will require the Republican Party as a whole to prioritize recruiting women—and not just for one election cycle, but in a sustained way.
republican.translationZh: 这将要求共和党作为一个整体优先招募女性——而且不仅仅是为了一个选举周期，而是要以持续的方式进行。
republican.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

republican.sentenceEn: In the next Congress, there will be 107 female Democratic lawmakers and 42 female Republican lawmakers in the Senate and House combined.
republican.translationZh: 在下一届国会中，参众两院将共有107名民主党女性议员和42名共和党女性议员。
republican.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

republican.sentenceEn: In order for women to gain half of the seats in Congress, more women need to run, especially on Republican tickets.
republican.translationZh: 要让女性在国会中获得半数席位，需要有更多女性参选，尤其是代表共和党参选。
republican.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

republican.sentenceEn: Interestingly, when participants were separated by party affiliation, this effect was significant among Republicans but not Democrats, suggesting that the kind of messages implicit in these TV shows may play into people's existing socioeconomic beliefs.
republican.translationZh: 有趣的是，当按党派划分参与者时，这种效应在共和党人中显著，而在民主党人中则不显著，这表明这些电视节目中隐含的信息类型可能会影响人们现有的社会经济信念。
republican.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

republican.sentenceEn: What can we infer from the passage about Republicans in general?
republican.translationZh: 关于共和党人总体而言，我们能从文章中推断出什么？

republican.sentenceEn: People have witnessed a tug of war between Republicans and Democrats over tax cuts.
republican.translationZh: 人们目睹了共和党与民主党之间围绕减税问题的激烈较量。

rescue.sentenceEn: Left alone on an unknown island with no apparent prospect of rescue or escape, Crusoe has much to lament(悲叹).
rescue.translationZh: 独自一人被困在一座陌生的岛屿上，没有明显的获救或逃生希望，鲁滨逊有太多事情可以悲叹。

rescue.sentenceEn: Co-founder Kresse Wesling said, "Late last year we launched an ambitious five-year partnership with the Burberry Foundation. The main aim of this is to scale our leather rescue project, starting with off-cuts from the production of Burberry leather goods. We are working tirelessly to expand our solutions and would love to welcome anyone to our workshop to come and see what we are doing."
rescue.translationZh: 联合创始人克雷斯·韦斯林表示：“去年年底，我们与博柏利基金会启动了一项雄心勃勃的五年合作计划。其主要目的是扩大我们的皮革回收项目规模，首先从博柏利皮革制品生产过程中产生的边角料入手。我们正在不懈努力拓展解决方案，非常欢迎任何人来我们的工作室参观我们的工作。”

rescue.sentenceEn: Instead of one big narrative, a story of unexpected rescue by a larger-than-life hero, we need multiple stories: we need stories, not only of what Rob Nixon of Princeton University has called the 'slow violence' of environmental degradation (that is, the damage that is often invisible at first and develops slowly and gradually), but also stories of what I call 'slow hope'.
rescue.translationZh: 我们需要的不是单一宏大的叙事——一个由传奇英雄意外拯救世界的故事，而是多元的故事：我们不仅需要普林斯顿大学的罗布·尼克松所说的环境恶化带来的“缓慢暴力”（即那种最初往往难以察觉、却在缓慢中逐渐加剧的破坏）的故事，也需要我所说的“缓慢希望”的故事。

rescue.sentenceEn: The fact that we now imagine our planet as a whole does not mean that the 'rescue' of our planet will come with one big global stroke of genius and technology.
rescue.translationZh: 如今我们将地球视为一个整体，但这并不意味着拯救地球的方法会是某种全球性的天才创见或技术突破。

rescue.sentenceEn: To prevent that event from becoming a catastrophe, first responders will join members of the public in rehearsals that involve communication, evacuation, search and rescue , and other scenarios.
rescue.translationZh: 为防止该事件演变为灾难，急救人员将与公众一起参与演练，内容包括通信、疏散、搜救及其他场景。
rescue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

rescue.sentenceEn: However, robots are coming to the rescue .
rescue.translationZh: 然而，机器人正在前来救援。
rescue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

resentment.sentenceEn: And it can generate feelings of resentment and jealousy.
resentment.translationZh: 并且它可能会引发怨恨和嫉妒的情绪。
resentment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

resentment.sentenceEn: While the residents of most cities display pride and support for their home industries, drastic market distortions in the San Francisco Bay Area have created boiling resentment in the region towards the tech industry.
resentment.translationZh: 虽然大多数城市的居民都会对本土产业表现出自豪与支持，但旧金山湾区严重的市场扭曲却在当地引发了对科技行业的强烈不满。

resentment.sentenceEn: In the face of resentment , it is human to want revenge.
resentment.translationZh: 面对这种怨恨情绪，人们很自然地会产生报复心理。

resentment.sentenceEn: Broadly speaking, a community in which people feel grateful to one another is likely to be a more pleasant place to live than one characterized by mutual suspicion and resentment .
resentment.translationZh: 广义而言，一个人们彼此心怀感激的社区，很可能比一个充满相互猜疑与怨恨的社区更适宜居住。

resentment.sentenceEn: Simply put, for most of us, it is far more helpful to focus on the things in life for which we can express gratitude than those that incline us toward resentment and lamentation.
resentment.translationZh: 简而言之，对我们大多数人而言，将注意力集中在生活中那些值得我们感恩的事情上，远比关注那些容易让我们产生怨恨和悲叹的事情要有益得多。

resentment.sentenceEn: Smash the toys to release their bottled-up resentments .
resentment.translationZh: 打碎玩具来释放他们压抑的怨气。

resort.sentenceEn: On the contrary, when people stay at large resorts or on cruise ships, they make most of their purchases there, leaving local communities little opportunity to benefit from tourist spending.
resort.translationZh: 相反，当人们入住大型度假村或乘坐游轮时，他们的大部分消费都发生在这些场所内，这使得当地社区几乎没有机会从游客消费中获益。
resort.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

resort.sentenceEn: Because great numbers of people go there, the islanders have built elaborate resorts , developed harbors and airfields, improved the beaches and have expanded sea and air routes.
resort.translationZh: 由于大量游客前往这些岛屿，岛民们修建了豪华度假村，开发了港口和机场，改善了海滩，并拓展了海上和空中航线。
resort.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

resort.sentenceEn: Throughout the 2008 financial crisis and the recession and recovery that followed, central banks have taken on the role of stimulators of last resort , holding up the global economy with vast amounts of money in the form of asset buying.
resort.translationZh: 在2008年金融危机以及随后的经济衰退和复苏期间，各国央行扮演了最后刺激者的角色，通过大规模资产购买计划向市场注入巨额资金，以支撑全球经济。
resort.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

resort.sentenceEn: That helps explain why, as I'm First's Rubinoff indicated, the schools to which these students end up resorting can end up being some of the poorest matches for them.
resort.translationZh: 这也解释了为何正如“我是第一代”组织的鲁宾诺夫所指出的，这些学生最终选择的学校往往是最不适合他们的。

resort.sentenceEn: Higher institutions will be concerned about compromising the integrity of classical music if they have to resort to the television medium.
resort.translationZh: 如果高等音乐机构不得不借助电视媒介，它们将会担心这会损害古典音乐的完整性。

resort.sentenceEn: Resort to all means regardless of the consequences.

resurrection.sentenceEn: What Farrant and others have found over the past two decades is that there are many genes involved in resurrection plants' response to dryness.
resurrection.translationZh: 在过去二十年中，法兰特和其他研究人员发现，复苏植物应对干旱的过程涉及许多基因。

resurrection.sentenceEn: Now they are trying to figure out what molecular signaling processes activate those seed-building genes in resurrection plants—and how to reproduce them in crops.
resurrection.translationZh: 现在，他们正试图弄清楚是什么分子信号过程激活了复苏植物中那些种子形成基因——以及如何在农作物中重现这些过程。

resurrection.sentenceEn: The Queensland rock violet is one of the best studied resurrection plants so far, with a draft genome(基因图谱) published last year by a Chinese team.
resurrection.translationZh: 昆士兰岩堇是目前研究最为深入的复苏植物之一，中国研究团队已于去年公布了其基因组草图。

resurrection.sentenceEn: Farrant calls them resurrection plants(复苏植物).
resurrection.translationZh: 法兰特将它们称为复苏植物。

resurrection.sentenceEn: Resurrection plants, defined as those capable of recovering from holding less than 0.1 grams of water per gram of dry mass, are different.
resurrection.translationZh: 复苏植物的定义是能够从每克干重含水量低于0.1克的状态中恢复过来的植物，它们则有所不同。

resurrection.sentenceEn: Resurrection plants can come back to life in a short time after a rainfall.
resurrection.translationZh: 复苏植物在降雨后短时间内就能恢复生机。

rationality.sentenceEn: Presumably it's an appeal to rationality of some sort that forms the basis of more complex reasoning.
rationality.translationZh: 想必这是对某种理性的诉求，而这种理性构成了更复杂推理的基础。
rationality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

rationality.sentenceEn: The trend toward rationality and enlightenment was endangered long before the advent of the World Wide Web.
rationality.translationZh: 早在万维网出现之前，理性与启蒙的趋势就已岌岌可危。
rationality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rationality.sentenceEn: As Neil Postman noted in his 1985 book Amusing Ourselves to Death, the rise of television introduced not just a new medium but a new discourse: a gradual shift from a typographic(印刷的) culture to a photographic one, which in turn meant a shift from rationality to emotions, exposition to entertainment.
rationality.translationZh: 正如尼尔·波兹曼在其1985年著作《娱乐至死》中所指出的，电视的兴起不仅带来了一种新媒介，更带来了一种新的话语方式：从印刷文化向影像文化的逐步转变，而这反过来又意味着从理性向情感、从阐述向娱乐的转变。
rationality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

rationality.sentenceEn: Piaget and his followers maintained that children go through something like a dark age of intellectual development before slowly and gradually becoming enlightened by reason and rationality as they reach school age.
rationality.translationZh: 皮亚杰及其追随者认为，儿童在进入学龄期前会经历一个类似智力发展"黑暗时代"的阶段，之后才会慢慢被理性和理智所启蒙。

rationality.sentenceEn: Indeed, our schools and universities are structured to mould pupils to be mostly obedient servants of rationality , and to develop outdated skills in interacting with outdated machines.
rationality.translationZh: 事实上，我们的中小学和大学的教育体系旨在将学生塑造成主要是理性的顺从执行者，并培养他们与过时机器交互的过时技能。
rationality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

rationality.sentenceEn: It originates in the rationality of people around the world.
rationality.translationZh: 它源于世界各地人们的理性。

recipe.sentenceEn: But could we learn something more from them than recipes and techniques?
recipe.translationZh: 但我们能从它们那里学到的仅仅是食谱和技巧吗？
recipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

recipe.sentenceEn: Tan's job is to create recipes with these still-unfamiliar ingredients that will appeal to both local and international tastes.
recipe.translationZh: 谭的工作是用这些尚不为人熟悉的食材创作出既能吸引本地口味又能满足国际味蕾的食谱。

recipe.sentenceEn: "I try to modernise forgotten crops instead of using old recipes ." says Tan, who is also a trained chef.
recipe.translationZh: 身为专业厨师的谭说：“我尝试让那些被遗忘的农作物现代化，而不是沿用旧食谱。”

recipe.sentenceEn: We build intricate habitats, devise complex recipes for our food, wear clothes that reflect constant changes in fashion, communicate with elaborate signs, symbols, and sounds, and travel between habitats on wings and wheels of our own design.
recipe.translationZh: 我们建造精巧复杂的居所，设计五花八门的食谱，穿着紧跟时尚潮流变化的服装，通过繁复的手势、符号和声音进行交流，还借助自己设计的翅膀与车轮穿梭于不同的栖息地之间。
recipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

recipe.sentenceEn: One biologist shared an intricate analogy involving a library, books, paper, a recipe , ingredients, and a cake to explain the process behind vaccines.
recipe.translationZh: 有一位生物学家曾用一个复杂的类比来解释疫苗背后的作用机制，其中涉及图书馆、书籍、纸张、食谱、原料和蛋糕。
recipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

recipe.sentenceEn: They attach little importance to recipes .

regional.sentenceEn: "Unite is concerned that without safeguards, any benefits will bypass workers in low-paying jobs, such as waiters," says the union's London regional officer, Dave Turnbull.
regional.translationZh: 工会（Unite）驻伦敦区域官员戴夫·特恩布尔表示，该工会担心，如果没有保障措施，任何利益都将与服务员等低薪岗位的工人擦肩而过。

regional.sentenceEn: Will it be one where the elite command the vast bulk of wealth and regional culture is defined by an aggressive business world?
regional.translationZh: 我们会成为一个由精英阶层掌控绝大部分财富、区域文化被激进商业世界所定义的社会吗？

regional.sentenceEn: It is time that we showed successes and accelerations in ecological awareness, action and restoration: stories that include past successes and future visions about the rise of urban gardening and of renaturalised riverscapes, of successful protests against polluted air and water, of the rise of regional markets and slow food, and the planting of trees around the globe, of initiatives and enterprises that work towards ecological restoration.
regional.translationZh: 现在是时候展示我们在生态意识、行动和恢复方面取得的成功和进展了：这些故事应包含过去的成就和未来的愿景，如城市园艺的兴起、河流景观的自然化修复、成功抗议空气和水污染的行动、区域市场和慢食运动的发展、全球植树造林，以及致力于生态恢复的各类倡议和企业。

regional.sentenceEn: In recent decades, environmental threats have expanded beyond regional boundaries to have global reach and, most hauntingly, are multiplying at a dizzying rate.
regional.translationZh: 近几十年来，环境威胁已超越区域界限，蔓延至全球范围，而最令人不安的是，其增长速度快得令人眩晕。

regional.sentenceEn: Through regular regional educational meetings, a large annual meeting, individual farm visits and thousands of phone calls, the Amburghs pass on the principles of pasture management.
regional.translationZh: 阿姆伯格夫妇通过定期的区域性教育会议、大型年度会议、农场实地走访以及数千次电话交流，将牧场管理的理念传递给其他农户。

regional.sentenceEn: Many smaller regional banks are going to fail.
regional.translationZh: 许多规模较小的地区性银行将会倒闭。

register.sentenceEn: So far this year, it says an unprecedented 1,956 have been registered .
register.translationZh: 该协会表示，今年到目前为止，已有前所未有的1956种产品完成注册。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

register.sentenceEn: The Animal Free Product Society says they've seen a boom in products registered with the vegan trademark.
register.translationZh: 无动物产品协会表示，他们发现带有纯素商标的产品数量激增。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

register.sentenceEn: I registered to take a safe driving course to improve my real-life driving skills.
register.translationZh: 我报名参加了一个安全驾驶课程，以提高我的实际驾驶技能。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

register.sentenceEn: "The typical American diet is a lot higher in protein than a lot of us think," says registered dietitian Angela Pipitone.
register.translationZh: 注册营养师安吉拉·皮皮托内说：“典型的美国人饮食中的蛋白质含量比我们很多人想象的要高得多。”

register.sentenceEn: But thinking about or remembering descriptions in terms of their social meaning activated the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex—part of the brain's social network—even as traditional memory regions registered low levels of activity.
register.translationZh: 但当受试者从社交意义的角度思考或回忆描述内容时，背内侧前额叶皮层——大脑社交网络的一部分——会被激活，而传统记忆区域的活动水平则较低。

register.sentenceEn: The potential liability for retailers using magstripe is far more costly than upgrading their registers .
register.translationZh: 对于使用磁条技术的零售商而言，潜在责任远比升级收银机的成本高得多。

religion.sentenceEn: Some cooks call it their religion .
religion.translationZh: 有些厨师视烹饪为信仰。
religion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

religion.sentenceEn: They found that the seven rules were considered morally good in all societies and were observed across all continents, religions and politics.
religion.translationZh: 他们发现，这七条规则在所有社会中都被认为是道德上的善举，并且在各大洲、各种宗教和政治背景下都得到遵守。
religion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

religion.sentenceEn: For example, adherents of some religions offer prayers of thanksgiving every morning before rising and every night before lying down to sleep.
religion.translationZh: 例如，一些宗教的信徒每天早上起床前和晚上睡前都会进行感恩祈祷。

religion.sentenceEn: People form prejudices against others for many reasons—differences in their race, religion , gender, or occupation.
religion.translationZh: 人们对他人产生偏见的原因有很多——种族、宗教、性别或职业的差异。
religion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

religion.sentenceEn: It can reveal information about protected characteristics like age, race, nationality, disability, gender, religion , etc., and that could bias a hiring decision.
religion.translationZh: 这可能会泄露有关受保护特征的信息，如年龄、种族、国籍、残疾状况、性别、宗教信仰等，而这可能会使招聘决策产生偏差。
religion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

religion.sentenceEn: Otherwise, the work becomes religion or faith.
religion.translationZh: 否则，这项工作就成了宗教或信仰。

rent.sentenceEn: They are also better situated to take unpaid internships to get their foot in the door while their parents pay their rent .
rent.translationZh: 他们的处境也更有利，可以从事无薪实习来迈出职场第一步，同时由父母支付房租。
rent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

rent.sentenceEn: While B&Bs usually have low initial costs, experts estimate it would take at least five rooms rented regularly for the host to earn a living from B&B.
rent.translationZh: 虽然民宿的初始成本通常较低，但专家估计，房东至少需要定期出租五间客房才能以此维生。
rent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

rent.sentenceEn: Considering that the average household income in the city currently stands at around $80,000, it is not an exaggeration to say that the dream of home ownership is now beyond the grasp of the vast majority of today's people who rent .
rent.translationZh: 鉴于该市目前的家庭平均收入约为8万美元，可以毫不夸张地说，对于如今绝大多数租房者而言，拥有住房的梦想已遥不可及。

rent.sentenceEn: W: So, I've been thinking, this summer, instead of our usual holiday rental, I'd like to try renting a camper van and exploring a bit more.
rent.translationZh: 女：是这样，我一直在想，今年夏天我们别像往常一样租度假屋了，我想试试租辆房车，多出去转转。
rent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rent.sentenceEn: The place actually belongs to my mother, but her health isn't great, so we finally managed to persuade her to move in with us and rent this old place out.
rent.translationZh: 这套房子其实是我母亲的，但她身体不太好，所以我们最终说服她搬来和我们一起住，把这个老房子租出去。
rent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

rent.sentenceEn: Pay the first month's rent and a deposit.

representative.sentenceEn: Former U.S. representative Chester Atkins says it's because the Puritan founding fathers were themselves impatient and bad-tempered, and had little time for courtesy.
representative.translationZh: 前美国众议员切斯特·阿特金斯表示，这是因为清教徒开国元勋们本身就缺乏耐心且脾气暴躁，几乎没有时间讲究礼貌。
representative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

representative.sentenceEn: The people she invites to meetings today include not just the essential employees, but also representatives from every department that might have a stake in the issue at hand.
representative.translationZh: 她今天邀请参加会议的人员不仅包括必要的员工，还包括可能与当前问题有利益关系的每个部门的代表。

representative.sentenceEn: In August, 173 marine scientists signed an open letter to the government saying they were "greatly concerned" that the proposals for the southwestern region had not been based on the "core science principles" of reserves—the protected regions were not, for instance, representative of all the habitats in the region, they said.
representative.translationZh: 今年8月，173位海洋科学家联名致函政府，表达了他们的“深切担忧”：西南海域保护区提案未能遵循保护区设立的“核心科学原则”——例如，受保护区域未能代表该地区所有的栖息地类型。
representative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

representative.sentenceEn: None of these concerns seem to have been appreciated by the EAT-Lancet Commission's representative , Brent Loken, who said "India has got such a great example" in sourcing protein from plants.
representative.translationZh: 然而，EAT-柳叶刀委员会的代表布伦特·洛肯（Brent Loken）似乎完全没有意识到这些问题，他还称印度在植物蛋白获取方面"树立了极好的榜样"。
representative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

representative.sentenceEn: What does Pennsylvania state representative Scott Petri say is the best way to help the long-term unemployed?
representative.translationZh: 宾夕法尼亚州众议员斯科特·佩特里认为帮助长期失业者的最佳方式是什么？

representative.sentenceEn: They are not based on a representative sampling.
representative.translationZh: 它们并非基于具有代表性的抽样。

rigorous.sentenceEn: According to its catalog, a college education at Sterling combines " rigorous academics, roll-up-your-sleeves challenges, and good old hard work."
rigorous.translationZh: 据其招生简章介绍，斯特林学院的大学教育融合了"严谨的学术研究、亲力亲为的实践挑战以及纯粹的辛勤付出"。

rigorous.sentenceEn: This education develops the skills of critical thinking, rigorous analysis of data and facts, communication with the written and spoken word, understanding of cultural differences and issues, and the ability to keep learning.
rigorous.translationZh: 这种教育培养学生的批判性思维能力、对数据和事实的严谨分析能力、书面与口头表达能力、对文化差异和文化问题的理解能力，以及持续学习的能力。
rigorous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

rigorous.sentenceEn: One way we can check our internal biases and inconsistencies is through the social verification of knowledge, in which we test our ideas in a rigorous and systematic way to see if they make sense not just to us, but to other people.
rigorous.translationZh: 我们可以通过知识的社会验证来检验自身的偏见和矛盾，即在这一过程中，我们以严谨系统的方式检验自己的观点，看它们不仅对我们自己有意义，对他人是否也同样有意义。
rigorous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

rigorous.sentenceEn: It requires rigorous training and instruction.
rigorous.translationZh: 这需要严格的训练和指导。
rigorous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

rigorous.sentenceEn: In a certain tiny college, rigorous academic work and traditional manual labor are integrated.
rigorous.translationZh: 在某所小型学院中，严谨的学术工作与传统体力劳动融为一体。

rigorous.sentenceEn: They are conducted in a more rigorous manner.
rigorous.translationZh: 这些研究采用了更为严谨的方式进行。

radically.sentenceEn: W: Frank, you support radically changing universities in America?
radically.translationZh: 弗兰克，你支持彻底改革美国的大学教育吗？
radically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

radically.sentenceEn: The sense is that for people prone to depression, meeting their negative thoughts and feelings with compassion is a radically different way; that these thoughts are not facts.
radically.translationZh: 我们的体会是，对于易患抑郁症的人而言，以同情心面对自己的消极想法和感受是一种截然不同的方式；要明白这些想法并非事实。
radically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

radically.sentenceEn: Computers increasingly become principal actors in leveraging data to formulate questions, which requires radically new ways of reasoning.
radically.translationZh: 计算机正日益成为利用数据提出问题的核心角色，这需要全新的推理方式。

radically.sentenceEn: You have so many applications and software and platforms that are going to come in and provide information and service in these two fields, which means a lot of healthcare and education sectors will be radically changed and a lot of jobs will be lost.
radically.translationZh: 未来将涌现大量应用程序、软件和平台，它们将进入这两个领域并提供信息与服务，这意味着医疗和教育行业的诸多领域将发生根本性变革，许多工作岗位也将消失。
radically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

radically.sentenceEn: It radically transformed the state's economy.
radically.translationZh: 这彻底改变了该州的经济。

reference.sentenceEn: Nice to meet you, I spoke to all your references and they all checked out okay.
reference.translationZh: 很高兴见到你。我联系了你所有的推荐人，他们的评价都很好。
reference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

reference.sentenceEn: Before you can criticize an idea, you have to reference that idea.
reference.translationZh: 在你能够批评一个观点之前，你必须先提及这个观点。

reference.sentenceEn: But a passing reference in a recent profile by Glamour magazine to her 20-hour workdays prompted an outpouring of admiration.
reference.translationZh: 但《魅力》杂志近期一篇人物专访中顺带提及她每日工作20小时，引发了人们对她的由衷赞叹。
reference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

reference.sentenceEn: Instead, thoughts make sense only in reference to the individual's external world.
reference.translationZh: 相反，思想只有参照个体的外部世界才有意义。
reference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

reference.sentenceEn: She received assistance naming plants, making sketches and referencing the work of others.
reference.translationZh: 她在植物命名、草图绘制以及参考他人研究成果方面得到了帮助。

reference.sentenceEn: Check the references of the flat owner.
reference.translationZh: 核实公寓房东的推荐信

refine.sentenceEn: But they can in no way replace the child's growing ability to articulate and refine her understanding of how people behave and why.
refine.translationZh: 但这些行为绝不能取代儿童日益增长的能力，即清晰表达并不断完善自己对人们行为方式及其原因的理解。

refine.sentenceEn: Scholars sought to refine his theory and empirically confirm his views.
refine.translationZh: 学者们试图完善他的理论并用实证方法证实他的观点。

refine.sentenceEn: Instead of trying to refine old formulas, they invent new ones.
refine.translationZh: 他们不试图改良旧有方法，而是创造新的模式。
refine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

refine.sentenceEn: As you acquire a distinctive identity your attitudes are further refined by the behavior of those with whom you identify—your family, those of your gender and culture, and the people you admire, even though you may not know them personally.
refine.translationZh: 当你形成独特的自我认同后，你所认同之人的行为会进一步塑造你的态度——包括你的家人、与你同性别和同文化背景的人，以及你所敬佩的人，即便你可能并不认识他们。
refine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

refine.sentenceEn: About that same time and throughout adulthood, the information you receive, especially when ideas are repeated in association with goals and achievements you find attractive, also refines your attitudes.
refine.translationZh: 大约在同一时期以及整个成年阶段，你所接收的信息，尤其是当某些想法与你认为有吸引力的目标和成就相关联并被反复提及的时候，也会进一步塑造你的态度。
refine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

refine.sentenceEn: They are good at refining old formulas.
refine.translationZh: 他们擅长改进旧有方法。

relieve.sentenceEn: While we did not directly assess how cyberloafing affects worker performance, we believe by relieving stress it may not only reduce worker turnover, but also ultimately bolster productivity.
relieve.translationZh: 虽然我们并未直接评估网络摸鱼对员工绩效的影响，但我们认为，通过缓解压力，它不仅可以减少员工流失，还能最终提高生产力。
relieve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

relieve.sentenceEn: Accepting that weight is predetermined can relieve guilt for overweight people.
relieve.translationZh: 接受体重是先天决定的这一观点，可以减轻超重人群的负罪感。
relieve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

relieve.sentenceEn: Ask your pharmacist whether he can suggest a drug that will relieve the symptoms but that will not cause the adverse reaction.
relieve.translationZh: 询问你的药剂师，看他能否推荐一种既能缓解症状又不会引起不良反应的药物。
relieve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

relieve.sentenceEn: Cyberloafing may relieve employees of stress.
relieve.translationZh: 网络摸鱼可以帮助员工缓解压力。

restrict.sentenceEn: However, its strict adherence to social cohesiveness and exclusiveness restricts expression and practice of individual differences and preferences.
restrict.translationZh: 然而，由于其严格遵循社会凝聚力和排他性，限制了个体差异与偏好的表达与实践。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

restrict.sentenceEn: They also recommend that people simultaneously endeavor to restrict consumption of sweets, sugar and red meat.
restrict.translationZh: 他们还建议人们同时努力限制甜食、糖和红肉的摄入。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

restrict.sentenceEn: Ministers, according to Onward, should "crack down on courses that offer extremely limited value for money to students ten years after graduation", restricting the ability of such courses to recruit new students, if the average graduate earns below the student loans payment threshold.
restrict.translationZh: 前进智库认为，部长们应该“严厉打击那些在毕业生离校十年后仍无法为其带来足够经济回报的课程”，如果某课程毕业生的平均收入低于学生贷款还款门槛，就应限制该类课程的招生名额。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

restrict.sentenceEn: Of course cities still need to foster standard public health practices, such as separating toxic facilities from homes and restricting heavy truck traffic through dense residential areas.
restrict.translationZh: 当然，城市仍然需要推行标准的公共卫生措施，例如将有毒设施与住宅区分离，并限制重型卡车在人口密集的居民区通行。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

restrict.sentenceEn: Using public spaces in cities as places where people can exercise promotes equity, rather than allowing physical activity to become restricted to private gyms with often-expensive monthly fees that deter less wealthy people from joining.
restrict.translationZh: 将城市公共空间用作人们可以锻炼的场所能够促进公平，而非让体育活动局限于私人健身房——这些健身房往往收取昂贵的月费，使不太富裕的人群望而却步。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

restrict.sentenceEn: Restrict the ability of creative arts courses to recruit new students.
restrict.translationZh: 限制创意艺术类课程招收新生的名额

revise.sentenceEn: The American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), which first issued that recommendation back in 1999, has extensively updated and revised its guidelines for children and adolescents to reflect new research and new habits.
revise.translationZh: 美国儿科学会(AAP)早在1999年首次提出这一建议，如今已对其儿童和青少年指南进行了全面更新和修订，以反映新的研究成果和新的习惯。
revise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

revise.sentenceEn: Part of the motivation to revise some of Piaget's conclusions stemmed from an ideological shift about the origin of human knowledge that occurred in the second half of the 20th century.
revise.translationZh: 修正皮亚杰部分结论的动机，源于20世纪下半叶发生的一场关于人类知识起源的思想转变。

revise.sentenceEn: The commission's revised "Green Guides" warn marketers against using labels that make broad claims, like "eco-friendly".
revise.translationZh: 委员会修订后的《绿色指南》警告营销人员不得使用诸如“环保”之类的宽泛声明标签。
revise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

revise.sentenceEn: What do the revised "Green Guides" require businesses to do?
revise.translationZh: 修订后的《绿色指南》要求企业做什么？

revise.sentenceEn: Revise its conservation plan owing to criticisms.
revise.translationZh: 因受到批评而修改其保护计划

revolutionize.sentenceEn: As I was born poor and in the countryside, the simple rural life seldom loses its appeal to me, but as my station changes, I have an opportunity to mingle with the newly rich, an experience which has revolutionized my view of lifestyle.
revolutionize.translationZh: 我出身贫寒，长在农村，简单的田园生活对我始终有着特殊的吸引力。然而，随着社会地位的变化，我有机会接触到新富阶层，这段经历彻底改变了我对生活方式的看法。
revolutionize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

revolutionize.sentenceEn: There is huge potential for artificial intelligence and machine learning to revolutionize agriculture by integrating these technologies into critical markets on a global scale.
revolutionize.translationZh: 通过将人工智能和机器学习技术整合到全球关键市场中，这些技术在彻底变革农业方面具有巨大潜力。

revolutionize.sentenceEn: But today, on the 10th anniversary of the iPhone, let's take a moment to consider a less obvious advantage: the potential for smartphone technology to revolutionize behavioral science.
revolutionize.translationZh: 但今天，在iPhone问世十周年之际，让我们花点时间来思考一个不太明显的优势：智能手机技术有潜力彻底改变行为科学。
revolutionize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

revolutionize.sentenceEn: With information no longer controlled by travel agents or hidden in business networks, the travel industry was revolutionized , as greater transparency helped slash prices.
revolutionize.translationZh: 由于信息不再由旅行社掌控或隐藏在商业网络中，旅游业发生了革命性变革，更高的透明度助推了价格的大幅下降。
revolutionize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

revolutionize.sentenceEn: Businesses profit from selling mobile phones and revolutionizing social media.
revolutionize.translationZh: 企业通过销售手机和革新社交媒体来获取利润。

ritual.sentenceEn: When she went to the gym, her daily ritual predominantly involved easy exercise options like jogging; she avoided more formidable exercises like lifting weights.
ritual.translationZh: 她去健身房时，日常习惯主要是进行慢跑这类轻松的运动；她会避开举重等难度较大的锻炼。
ritual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

ritual.sentenceEn: It gives us a set of rituals to perform and promises that if we do so we'll be able to wield power over others.
ritual.translationZh: 它为我们提供了一套仪式来执行，并承诺如果我们这样做，就能拥有支配他人的权力。

ritual.sentenceEn: Fruitful debates might actually take place in this area, as opposed to the familiar ritual we've become accustomed to of condemnation met with counter-condemnation.
ritual.translationZh: 在这一领域或许能开展富有成效的辩论，而非我们早已习惯的那种相互谴责的熟悉套路。

ritual.sentenceEn: Now, it's become something of a ritual to debate the value of a college degree, but as Current Population Survey data show, there has been a sharp decline in employment among men without college degrees compared with those who have them.
ritual.translationZh: 如今，争论大学学位的价值已成为一种常态，但美国当前人口调查（Current Population Survey）数据显示，与拥有大学学位的男性相比，没有大学学位的男性就业率出现了急剧下降。
ritual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ritual.sentenceEn: Throwing spare change into a fountain is a time-honored ritual : throw a penny into the water, and your wish might come true.
ritual.translationZh: 往喷泉里投掷零钱是一项历史悠久的传统习俗：向水中投一枚硬币，你的愿望或许就能实现。
ritual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ritual.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say has become something of a ritual ?
ritual.translationZh: 演讲者说什么已经成了一种习惯性的事？

rob.sentenceEn: And yet, robbed of the engagement with our neighbors and with our local communities that our ancestors were forced into by circumstance, we feel ourselves to be more and more independent of one another.
rob.translationZh: 然而，当我们不再像先辈那样因环境所迫而必须与邻里和当地社区紧密交往时，我们却感觉彼此间的独立性越来越强了。

rob.sentenceEn: At the same time, when a system no longer provides opportunities for the majority to participate in wealth building, it not only robs those who are excluded from opportunities, but also deprives them of their dignity.
rob.translationZh: 同时，当一个体制不再为大多数人提供参与财富积累的机会时，它不仅剥夺了那些被排除在外的人的机会，也剥夺了他们的尊严。

rob.sentenceEn: A variety of factors have conspired to rob us of time for reflection about ourselves and our lives.
rob.translationZh: 多种因素共同作用，剥夺了我们反思自我和生活的时间。
rob.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

rob.sentenceEn: Rob MeInerney, head of the International Road Assessment Programme, says that all countries tend to go through three phases.
rob.translationZh: 国际道路评估计划负责人罗布·迈纳尼表示，所有国家往往都会经历三个阶段。
rob.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

rob.sentenceEn: If I'm spending too much time worrying over what to have for lunch, I'm robbing myself of the energy to focus on the things that matter.
rob.translationZh: 如果我花太多时间纠结午餐吃什么，那我就是在浪费精力，无法专注于真正重要的事情。
rob.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

rob.sentenceEn: They rob users of their ability to observe experience.
rob.translationZh: 它们剥夺了用户观察体验的能力。

rough.sentenceEn: On one very rough ferry crossing, on the route to the Isles of Scilly, for example, my traveling companion spent the entire 3-hour-ride throwing up in the bathroom, while I dozed happily on a plastic chair.
rough.translationZh: 例如，在一次前往锡利群岛的颠簸渡轮旅程中，我的旅伴在卫生间里吐了整整3个小时，而我却在塑料椅子上睡得很香。
rough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

rough.sentenceEn: Dogs do know when their human companions are having a rough time.
rough.translationZh: 狗狗确实知道它们的人类伙伴什么时候正经历艰难时期。
rough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

rough.sentenceEn: The new sensors relayed rough measurements about water height and movement to a computer at the Virginia Institute.
rough.translationZh: 这些新型传感器将有关水位高度和水流运动的大致测量数据传输至弗吉尼亚研究所的计算机中。
rough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第13句

rough.sentenceEn: Rough estimates of their population went as high as five billion and they accounted for around 40 percent of the total indigenous bird population of North America in the early 19th century.
rough.translationZh: 粗略估计，它们的数量高达50亿只，在19世纪初期占北美本土鸟类总数量的约40%。
rough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

rough.sentenceEn: As a teacher, I try to help them over the rough spots as best I can.
rough.translationZh: 作为一名教师，我尽我所能帮助他们度过难关。
rough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

rough.sentenceEn: They can sleep soundly during a rough ride at sea.
rough.translationZh: 即使在海上波涛汹涌的航行中，他们也能安然入睡。
